      <div class="tb-stat-val" id="uptimeTop">--:--:--</div>
    </div>
    <div class="tb-stat" style="border-right:none">
      <div class="tb-stat-label">
        <span class="dot6 ok" id="timerActiveDot" title="Licznik czasu rzeczywistego"></span>RTC TIMER
      </div>
      <div class="tb-stat-val" id="timerStatus" style="font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.05em">INIT</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="display:flex;gap:5px;align-items:center;padding:0 10px;flex-wrap:wrap" id="topbar-trays"></div>
  <div class="tb-right" id="topbarBadges"></div>
</header>

<nav class="tabs">
  <button class="tab active" data-tab="status" onclick="showTab('status')">■ Status</button>
  <button class="tab" data-tab="panel" onclick="showTab('panel')">▶ Sterowanie</button>
  <button class="tab" data-tab="dziennik" onclick="showTab('dziennik')">◎ Dziennik</button>
  <button class="tab" data-tab="serwis" onclick="showTab('serwis')">◈ Serwis / ESP</button>
  <button class="tab" data-tab="logi" onclick="showTab('logi')">≡ Logi</button>
</nav>

<!-- ===================== VIEW: STATUS ===================== -->
<div id="view-status" class="view active main">
  <div class="status-header">
    <div>
      <div class="vt-biglogo">VAULT&#x2011;TEC · HATCHERY CONTROL SYSTEM</div>
      <div class="vt-biglogo-sub">INCUBATION MANAGEMENT · v0.9 · PL</div>
    </div>
    <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:6px">
      <div class="pip-clock-block">
        <div class="pip-time" id="pip-clock">--:--:--</div>
        <div class="pip-date" id="pip-date">VAULT-TEC SYSTEM TIME</div>
      </div>
      <div class="clock-indicator">
        <span class="clock-dot" id="rtcDotAnim"></span>
        <span id="rtcStatusLabel">RTC TIMER: CZEKA</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- GAUGES ROW -->
  <div class="sec">Parametry komory</div>
  <div class="grid3" id="gauge-section-main">
    <div class="vtcard">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Temperatura komory · DS18B20 #1 <span>GPIO 6</span></div>
      <div class="gauge-outer">
        <canvas id="pip-temp" class="gauge-canvas" width="220" height="120"></canvas>
        <div class="gauge-range"><span id="g-temp-lo">0°C</span><span id="g-temp-hi">42°C</span></div>
        <div class="gauge-label-below" id="disp-temp0-big">--<span class="gauge-unit">°C</span></div>
        <div class="gauge-name">TEMP KOMORY</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="vtcard">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Wilgotność · DHT11 <span>GPIO 8</span></div>
      <div class="gauge-outer">
        <canvas id="pip-hum" class="gauge-canvas" width="220" height="120"></canvas>
        <div class="gauge-range"><span>30%</span><span>90%</span></div>
        <div class="gauge-label-below" id="disp-hum-big">--<span class="gauge-unit">%</span></div>
        <div class="gauge-name">WILGOTNOŚĆ</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="vtcard">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Temp. akwarium · DS18B20 #2 <span>GPIO 6</span></div>
      <div class="gauge-outer">
        <canvas id="pip-temp1" class="gauge-canvas" width="220" height="120"></canvas>
        <div class="gauge-range"><span>0°C</span><span>42°C</span></div>
        <div class="gauge-label-below" id="disp-temp1-big">--<span class="gauge-unit">°C</span></div>
        <div class="gauge-name">TEMP AKWARIUM</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- STATUS TACS + POWER -->
  <div class="sec">Tace inkubacyjne</div>
  <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 280px;gap:12px">
    <!-- Taca 1 -->
    <div class="vtcard">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Taca 1 · Status lęgu</div>
      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:center">
        <canvas id="pip-tray0" class="ring-canvas" width="180" height="180"></canvas>
      </div>
      <div class="tray-info-box">
        <div class="tray-phase" id="pip-tray0-phase" style="color:var(--vt-green)">--</div>
        <div class="tray-timer" id="pip-tray0-info">TACA 1</div>
      </div>
      <div class="hatch-status" style="margin-top:10px">
        <div class="hatch-title" id="hatch-title0">TACA 1 · --</div>
        <div class="hatch-dayline" id="hatch-dayline0">Dzień -- z -- · --%</div>
        <div class="hatch-timers">
          <span class="timer-chip" id="hatch-elapsed0">0d 0h 0m 0s</span>
          <span class="timer-chip down" id="hatch-remaining0">--</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <!-- Taca 2 -->
    <div class="vtcard">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Taca 2 · Status lęgu</div>
      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:center">
        <canvas id="pip-tray1" class="ring-canvas" width="180" height="180"></canvas>
      </div>
      <div class="tray-info-box">
        <div class="tray-phase" id="pip-tray1-phase" style="color:var(--vt-green)">--</div>
        <div class="tray-timer" id="pip-tray1-info">TACA 2</div>
      </div>
      <div class="hatch-status" style="margin-top:10px">
        <div class="hatch-title" id="hatch-title1">TACA 2 · --</div>
        <div class="hatch-dayline" id="hatch-dayline1">Dzień -- z -- · --%</div>
        <div class="hatch-timers">
          <span class="timer-chip" id="hatch-elapsed1">0d 0h 0m 0s</span>
          <span class="timer-chip down" id="hatch-remaining1">--</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <!-- Kontrola mocy -->
    <div class="vtcard">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Kontrola mocy</div>
      <div class="power-item">
        <div>
          <div class="power-key"><span class="dev-dot" id="dot-h0"></span> Grzałka CH0</div>
          <div class="power-val" id="pip-heater0-val">--%</div>
        </div>
        <label class="vt-switch"><input type="checkbox" id="sw-pip-h0" onchange="toggleHeaterPower(0,this.checked)"><span class="vt-track"></span></label>
      </div>
      <div class="power-item">
        <div>
          <div class="power-key"><span class="dev-dot" id="dot-h1"></span> Grzałka CH1</div>
          <div class="power-val" id="pip-heater1-val">--%</div>
        </div>
        <label class="vt-switch"><input type="checkbox" id="sw-pip-h1" onchange="toggleHeaterPower(1,this.checked)"><span class="vt-track"></span></label>
      </div>
      <div class="power-item">
        <div>
          <div class="power-key"><span class="dev-dot" id="dot-diff"></span> Dyfuzor</div>
          <div class="power-val" id="pip-diff-val" style="font-size:11px">--</div>
        </div>
        <label class="vt-switch"><input type="checkbox" id="sw-pip-diff" onchange="toggleDiffuserPower(this.checked)"><span class="vt-track"></span></label>
      </div>
      <div class="power-item">
        <div class="power-key">Taca 1</div>
        <label class="vt-switch"><input type="checkbox" id="sw-pip-tray0" onchange="toggleTrayPower(0,this.checked)"><span class="vt-track"></span></label>
      </div>
      <div class="power-item">
        <div class="power-key">Taca 2</div>
        <label class="vt-switch"><input type="checkbox" id="sw-pip-tray1" onchange="toggleTrayPower(1,this.checked)"><span class="vt-track"></span></label>
      </div>
      <!-- Alarmy -->
      <div style="margin-top:10px;min-height:40px" id="alerts-box">
        <div style="font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--vt-muted)">Brak alarmów</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ===================== VIEW: STEROWANIE ===================== -->
<div id="view-panel" class="view main">

  <div class="sec">Parametry · Wykresy</div>
  <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap">
    <button class="vtbtn" id="btn-gauge-toggle" onclick="toggleGauges()">Ukryj gauge</button>
    <button class="vtbtn" id="btn-bands-toggle" onclick="toggleBands()">Pasy ref: ON</button>
    <button class="vtbtn" id="btn-memory-mode" onclick="toggleMemorySaving()">Oszczędzanie pamięci: OFF</button>
    <button class="vtbtn" onclick="clearHistory()">Wyczyść historię</button>
    <button class="vtbtn vtbtn-info" onclick="exportCSV()">Export CSV</button>
    <span style="font-size:9px;color:var(--vt-muted);letter-spacing:.06em" id="memory-mode-label">MAX 30 000 próbek</span>
  </div>

  <div class="grid3 gauge-section" id="gauge-section-panel">
    <div class="vtcard" id="card-temp0">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Komora · DS18B20 #1</div>
      <div class="gauge-outer">
        <canvas id="p-temp0" class="gauge-canvas" width="200" height="110"></canvas>
        <div class="gauge-range"><span>0°C</span><span>42°C</span></div>
        <div class="gauge-label-below" id="disp-temp0">--<span class="gauge-unit">°C</span></div>
        <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--vt-muted);letter-spacing:.06em">Cel: <span id="disp-target">--</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="vtcard" id="card-temp1">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Akwarium · DS18B20 #2</div>
      <div class="gauge-outer">
        <canvas id="p-temp1" class="gauge-canvas" width="200" height="110"></canvas>
        <div class="gauge-range"><span>0°C</span><span>42°C</span></div>
        <div class="gauge-label-below" id="disp-temp1">--<span class="gauge-unit">°C</span></div>
        <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--vt-muted)">Wspólna linia 1-Wire</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="vtcard" id="card-hum">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Wilgotność · DHT11</div>
      <div class="gauge-outer">
        <canvas id="p-hum" class="gauge-canvas" width="200" height="110"></canvas>
        <div class="gauge-range"><span>30%</span><span>90%</span></div>
        <div class="gauge-label-below" id="disp-hum">--<span class="gauge-unit">%</span></div>
        <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--vt-muted)">Zakres: <span id="disp-hum-range">--</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="sec">Wykresy historyczne</div>
  <div class="grid2">
    <div class="vtcard">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Temperatura</div>
      <div class="chart-tabs">
        <button class="chart-tab active" data-metric="temp" data-range="1h" onclick="setChartRange('temp','1h')">1h</button>
        <button class="chart-tab" data-metric="temp" data-range="6h" onclick="setChartRange('temp','6h')">6h</button>
        <button class="chart-tab" data-metric="temp" data-range="24h" onclick="setChartRange('temp','24h')">24h</button>
        <button class="chart-tab" data-metric="temp" data-range="7d" onclick="setChartRange('temp','7d')">7d</button>
      </div>
      <div class="chart-pane main">
        <div class="chart-caption" id="chart-temp-caption">Ostatnia godzina</div>
        <canvas class="history-canvas main" id="chart-temp-main"></canvas>
      </div>
      <div class="chart-pane">
        <div class="chart-caption">Detal: ostatnie 45 min</div>
        <canvas class="history-canvas detail" id="chart-temp-detail"></canvas>
      </div>
      <div class="chart-legend">
        <div class="legend-item"><span class="legend-line" style="background:#7dd3fc"></span>Pomiar</div>
        <div class="legend-item"><span class="legend-band" style="background:rgba(34,197,94,.2);border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.4)"></span>Cel</div>
        <div class="legend-item"><span class="legend-band" style="background:rgba(239,68,68,.07);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.2)"></span>Alarm</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="vtcard">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Wilgotność</div>
      <div class="chart-tabs">
        <button class="chart-tab active" data-metric="hum" data-range="1h" onclick="setChartRange('hum','1h')">1h</button>
        <button class="chart-tab" data-metric="hum" data-range="6h" onclick="setChartRange('hum','6h')">6h</button>
        <button class="chart-tab" data-metric="hum" data-range="24h" onclick="setChartRange('hum','24h')">24h</button>
        <button class="chart-tab" data-metric="hum" data-range="7d" onclick="setChartRange('hum','7d')">7d</button>
      </div>
      <div class="chart-pane main">
        <div class="chart-caption" id="chart-hum-caption">Ostatnia godzina</div>
        <canvas class="history-canvas main" id="chart-hum-main"></canvas>
      </div>
      <div class="chart-pane">
        <div class="chart-caption">Detal: ostatnie 45 min</div>
        <canvas class="history-canvas detail" id="chart-hum-detail"></canvas>
      </div>
      <div class="chart-legend">
        <div class="legend-item"><span class="legend-line" style="background:#7dd3fc"></span>Pomiar</div>
        <div class="legend-item"><span class="legend-band" style="background:rgba(34,197,94,.2);border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.4)"></span>Cel</div>
        <div class="legend-item"><span class="legend-band" style="background:rgba(239,68,68,.07);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.2)"></span>Alarm</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="sec">Sterowanie grzałkami</div>
  <div class="grid2">
    <div class="vtcard" id="card-main-h0">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Grzałka 1 · CH0 <span class="mpill auto" id="pill-main-h0">AUTO</span></div>
      <div class="mini-live"><span><span class="dev-dot" id="ind-heat0"></span> CH0</span><strong id="disp-main-pwm0-mini">--%</strong></div>
      <div style="font-family:var(--font-vt);font-size:38px;color:var(--vt-green);line-height:1" id="disp-main-pwm0">--<span style="font-size:18px;color:var(--vt-muted)">%</span></div>
      <div class="ctrl-row" style="margin-top:8px">
        <div class="ctrl-lbl">Impuls</div>
        <label class="vt-switch"><input type="checkbox" id="sw-main-h0" checked onchange="toggleHeaterPower(0,this.checked)"><span class="vt-track"></span></label>
      </div>
      <div class="ctrl-row">
        <div class="ctrl-lbl">PWM %</div>
        <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="0" id="sl-main-h0" oninput="document.getElementById('sv-main-h0').textContent=this.value+'%'">
        <div class="ctrl-val" id="sv-main-h0">0%</div>
      </div>
      <div class="vtbtn-group">
        <button class="vtbtn" id="btn-main-h0-man" onclick="setHeaterManualMain(0)">Ręcznie</button>
        <button class="vtbtn" id="btn-main-h0-auto" onclick="setHeaterAutoMain(0)">Auto</button>
      </div>
      <div class="vmsg" id="st-main-h0"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="vtcard" id="card-main-h1">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Grzałka 2 · CH1 <span class="mpill auto" id="pill-main-h1">AUTO</span></div>
      <div class="mini-live"><span><span class="dev-dot" id="ind-heat1"></span> CH1</span><strong id="disp-main-pwm1-mini">--%</strong></div>
      <div style="font-family:var(--font-vt);font-size:38px;color:var(--vt-green);line-height:1" id="disp-main-pwm1">--<span style="font-size:18px;color:var(--vt-muted)">%</span></div>
      <div class="ctrl-row" style="margin-top:8px">
        <div class="ctrl-lbl">Impuls</div>
        <label class="vt-switch"><input type="checkbox" id="sw-main-h1" checked onchange="toggleHeaterPower(1,this.checked)"><span class="vt-track"></span></label>
      </div>
      <div class="ctrl-row">
        <div class="ctrl-lbl">PWM %</div>
        <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value="0" id="sl-main-h1" oninput="document.getElementById('sv-main-h1').textContent=this.value+'%'">
        <div class="ctrl-val" id="sv-main-h1">0%</div>
      </div>
      <div class="vtbtn-group">
        <button class="vtbtn" id="btn-main-h1-man" onclick="setHeaterManualMain(1)">Ręcznie</button>
        <button class="vtbtn" id="btn-main-h1-auto" onclick="setHeaterAutoMain(1)">Auto</button>
      </div>
      <div class="vmsg" id="st-main-h1"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="sec">Sterowanie tacami · Harmonogram</div>
  <div class="grid2">
    <!-- TACA 0 -->
    <div class="vtcard" id="card-tray0">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Taca 1 · Sterowanie <span class="vtbadge vtbadge-info" id="badge-tray0-species">--</span></div>
      <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--vt-muted);margin-bottom:8px" id="main-tray0-summary">Ostatni obrót: --</div>
      <div class="ctrl-row">
        <div class="ctrl-lbl">Impuls</div>
        <label class="vt-switch"><input type="checkbox" id="sw-tray0" checked onchange="toggleTrayPower(0,this.checked)"><span class="vt-track"></span></label>
      </div>
      <div class="ctrl-row">
        <div class="ctrl-lbl">Gatunek</div>
        <select id="main-species-tray0" style="max-width:200px" onchange="syncMainSpecies(0)">

          <option value="GOOSE">Gęś (30 dni)</option><option value="QUAIL">Przepiórka (17 dni)</option>
          <option value="GUINEA">Perliczka (26 dni)</option><option value="PHEASANT">Bażant (24 dni)</option>
        </select>
      </div>

        <div class="ctrl-lbl">Dzień</div>
        <input type="number" id="main-day-tray0" value="1" min="1" max="40" style="max-width:70px">

      </div>

        <div class="hatch-title" id="hatch-title0p">TACA 1 · --</div>

        <div class="hatch-timers">

          <span class="timer-chip down" id="hatch-remaining0p">--</span>

      </div>
      <div class="ctrl-row" style="margin-top:10px">
        <div class="ctrl-lbl">Czas ms</div>
        <input type="number" id="main-dur-tray0" value="15000" min="500" max="120000" step="500" style="max-width:100px">
        <input type="range" min="0" max="255" value="102" id="main-spd-tray0" oninput="document.getElementById('main-spd-val0').textContent=this.value">
        <div class="ctrl-val" id="main-spd-val0">102</div>
      </div>
      <button class="vtbtn vtbtn-full" id="btn-main-move0" onclick="moveTrayMain(0)">▶ Uruchom Tacę 1</button>
      <div class="vmsg" id="st-main-day0"></div>
      <!-- Harmonogram inline -->
      <div style="margin-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--vt-border);padding-top:10px">
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:6px">
          <div style="font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--vt-muted);text-transform:uppercase">Harmonogram</div>
          <span class="vtbadge vtbadge-ok" id="main-sched-badge0">--</span>
        </div>

          <table class="vt-table"><thead><tr><th>Dzień</th><th>Temp °C</th><th>Wilg %</th><th>Obrót</th><th>Lock</th><th>Uwagi</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody id="main-sched-body0"><tr><td colspan="6" style="color:var(--vt-muted);padding:10px">Ładowanie...</td></tr></tbody></table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <!-- TACA 1 -->
    <div class="vtcard" id="card-tray1">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Taca 2 · Sterowanie <span class="vtbadge vtbadge-info" id="badge-tray1-species">--</span></div>
      <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--vt-muted);margin-bottom:8px" id="main-tray1-summary">Ostatni obrót: --</div>
      <div class="ctrl-row">
        <div class="ctrl-lbl">Impuls</div>

      </div>
      <div class="ctrl-row">
        <div class="ctrl-lbl">Gatunek</div>

          <option value="GOOSE">Gęś (30 dni)</option><option value="QUAIL">Przepiórka (17 dni)</option>
          <option value="GUINEA">Perliczka (26 dni)</option><option value="PHEASANT">Bażant (24 dni)</option>
        </select>
      </div>

        <div class="ctrl-lbl">Dzień</div>
        <input type="number" id="main-day-tray1" value="1" min="1" max="40" style="max-width:70px">

      </div>
      <div class="hatch-status">
        <div class="hatch-title" id="hatch-title1p">TACA 2 · --</div>
        <div class="hatch-dayline" id="hatch-dayline1p">Dzień -- z --</div>
        <div class="hatch-timers">
          <span class="timer-chip" id="hatch-elapsed1p">0d 0h 0m 0s</span>
          <span class="timer-chip down" id="hatch-remaining1p">--</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="ctrl-row" style="margin-top:10px">
        <div class="ctrl-lbl">Czas ms</div>
        <input type="number" id="main-dur-tray1" value="15000" min="500" max="120000" step="500" style="max-width:100px">
        <input type="range" min="0" max="255" value="102" id="main-spd-tray1" oninput="document.getElementById('main-spd-val1').textContent=this.value">
        <div class="ctrl-val" id="main-spd-val1">102</div>
      </div>
      <button class="vtbtn vtbtn-full" id="btn-main-move1" onclick="moveTrayMain(1)">▶ Uruchom Tacę 2</button>
      <div class="vmsg" id="st-main-day1"></div>
      <!-- Harmonogram inline -->
      <div style="margin-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--vt-border);padding-top:10px">
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:6px">
          <div style="font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--vt-muted);text-transform:uppercase">Harmonogram</div>
          <span class="vtbadge vtbadge-ok" id="main-sched-badge1">--</span>
        </div>
        <div style="overflow-x:auto;max-height:260px;overflow-y:auto;">
          <table class="vt-table"><thead><tr><th>Dzień</th><th>Temp °C</th><th>Wilg %</th><th>Obrót</th><th>Lock</th><th>Uwagi</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody id="main-sched-body1"><tr><td colspan="6" style="color:var(--vt-muted);padding:10px">Ładowanie...</td></tr></tbody></table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="sec">Dyfuzor · Lockdown</div>
  <div class="grid2">
    <div class="vtcard" id="card-diff">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Dyfuzor pary · GPIO 21 <span class="mpill auto" id="pill-diff">AUTO</span></div>
      <div class="ctrl-row">
        <div class="ctrl-lbl">Impuls</div>
        <label class="vt-switch"><input type="checkbox" id="sw-diff" checked onchange="toggleDiffuserPower(this.checked)"><span class="vt-track"></span></label>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:10px 0">
        <div class="dev-dot" id="ind-diff"></div>
        <div>
          <div style="font-size:11px;font-weight:500">2PH63091A</div>
          <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--vt-muted)">Nawilżacz ultradźwiękowy</div>
        </div>
        <div style="margin-left:auto;font-size:11px;font-family:var(--font-vt);font-size:16px" id="txt-diff">--</div>
      </div>
      <div class="vtbtn-group">
        <button class="vtbtn" id="btn-diff-on" onclick="setDiffuser(1)">Włącz</button>
        <button class="vtbtn" id="btn-diff-off" onclick="setDiffuser(0)">Wyłącz</button>
        <button class="vtbtn" id="btn-diff-auto" onclick="setDiffuserAuto()">Auto</button>
      </div>
      <div class="vmsg" id="st-diff"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="vtcard" style="border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.3)">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Globalny Lockdown <span class="vtbadge vtbadge-hot">KRYTYCZNE</span></div>
      <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--vt-muted);margin-bottom:10px;letter-spacing:.03em">Ustawia obie tace w tryb lockdownu. Zatrzymuje obroty do wylęgu.</div>
      <div class="lockdown-preview" id="lockdown-tray-preview"></div>
      <button class="btn-lockdown" onclick="confirmGlobalLockdown()">&#128274; GLOBALNY LOCKDOWN — OBE TACE</button>
      <div class="vmsg" id="st-lockdown"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ===================== VIEW: DZIENNIK ===================== -->
<div id="view-dziennik" class="view main">
  <div class="sec">Nowy lęg · Wpisy dzienne</div>
  <div class="grid2">
    <div class="vtcard">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Nowy wpis startowy tacy</div>
      <div class="ctrl-row">
        <div class="ctrl-lbl">Z urządzenia</div>
        <select id="j-device-tray" style="max-width:180px"></select>
        <button class="vtbtn" onclick="journalSyncFromDevice()">Pobierz</button>
      </div>
      <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--vt-muted);margin-bottom:6px;padding-left:88px" id="j-device-hint"></div>
      <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Data startu</div><input type="date" id="j-start-date"></div>
      <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Taca/nazwa</div><input type="text" id="j-tray-name" placeholder="np. Taca 1 - lewa"></div>
      <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Gatunek</div><select id="j-species" onchange="updateEstimatedPreview()"><option value="CHICKEN">Kura</option><option value="DUCK">Kaczka</option><option value="GOOSE">Gęś</option><option value="QUAIL">Przepiórka</option><option value="GUINEA">Perliczka</option><option value="PHEASANT">Bażant</option></select></div>
      <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Rasa</div><input type="text" id="j-breed" placeholder="np. Leghorn"></div>
      <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Ilość jaj</div><input type="number" id="j-egg-count" min="1" max="500" value="20" style="max-width:80px"></div>
      <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Pozycja</div><input type="text" id="j-position" placeholder="np. poziom 2"></div>
      <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Szac. wylęg</div><input type="text" id="j-estimated" readonly></div>
      <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Uwagi</div><input type="text" id="j-start-notes" placeholder="np. jaja od młodej pary"></div>
      <div class="vtbtn-group"><button class="vtbtn" onclick="journalCreateBatch()">+ Dodaj lęg</button></div>
      <div class="vmsg" id="j-start-status"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="vtcard">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Wpis dzienny / ovoskop</div>
      <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Aktywny lęg</div><select id="j-note-batch" onchange="autoFillNoteDay()"></select></div>
      <div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--vt-muted);margin-bottom:6px;padding-left:88px;min-height:12px" id="j-note-batch-hint"></div>
      <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Data</div><input type="date" id="j-note-date" onchange="autoFillNoteDay()"></div>
      <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Dzień ink.</div><input type="number" id="j-note-day" min="1" max="60" placeholder="auto" style="max-width:70px"></div>
      <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Waga (g)</div><input type="number" id="j-note-weight" min="0" step="0.1" placeholder="opcj." style="max-width:100px"></div>
      <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Notatka</div><input type="text" id="j-note-text" placeholder="np. dzień 7: ovoskop OK"></div>
      <div style="border-top:1px solid var(--vt-border);margin:8px 0;padding-top:8px">
        <div style="font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--vt-muted);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:6px">Ovoskopia</div>
        <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Zapłodnione</div><input type="number" id="j-candled-fertile" min="0" placeholder="opcj." style="max-width:80px"></div>
        <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Clear eggs</div><input type="number" id="j-candled-clear" min="0" placeholder="opcj." style="max-width:80px"></div>
        <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Blood ring</div><input type="number" id="j-candled-blood" min="0" placeholder="opcj." style="max-width:80px"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="vtbtn-group"><button class="vtbtn" onclick="journalAddDailyNote()">Zapisz wpis</button></div>
      <div class="vmsg" id="j-note-status"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="grid2" style="margin-top:12px">
    <div class="vtcard">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Podsumowanie po wylęgu</div>
      <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Lęg</div><select id="j-summary-batch"></select></div>
      <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Zdrowe</div><input type="number" id="j-hatched-healthy" min="0" value="0" style="max-width:80px"></div>
      <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Słabe</div><input type="number" id="j-hatched-weak" min="0" value="0" style="max-width:80px"></div>
      <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Martwe</div><input type="number" id="j-hatched-dead" min="0" value="0" style="max-width:80px"></div>
      <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Uwagi</div><input type="text" id="j-summary-notes" placeholder="uwagi końcowe"></div>
      <div class="vtbtn-group"><button class="vtbtn" onclick="journalSaveSummary()">✓ Zamknij lęg</button></div>
      <div class="vmsg" id="j-summary-status"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="vtcard">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Przypomnienia</div>
      <div id="j-reminders" class="journal-list"></div>
      <div style="border-top:1px solid var(--vt-border);padding-top:10px;margin-top:8px">
        <div class="vtbtn-group">
          <button class="vtbtn" onclick="journalExportCSV()">Export CSV</button>
          <button class="vtbtn" onclick="journalPrintReport()">Raport PDF</button>
          <button class="vtbtn vtbtn-info" onclick="exportJournalJSON()">Export JSON</button>
          <label class="vtbtn" style="cursor:pointer">Import JSON<input type="file" accept=".json" style="display:none" onchange="importJournalJSON(event)"></label>
        </div>
        <button class="vtbtn vtbtn-danger vtbtn-full" style="margin-top:6px" onclick="clearJournal()">✗ Wyczyść cały dziennik</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="j-edit-panel" style="display:none">
    <div class="sec">Edycja lęgu</div>
    <div class="vtcard" style="border-color:rgba(56,189,248,.3)">
      <div class="vtcard-title">✎ Edytuj wpis startowy <button class="vtbtn" onclick="cancelEditBatch()" style="margin-left:auto">✕ Anuluj</button></div>
      <input type="hidden" id="j-edit-batch-id">
      <div class="grid2">
        <div>
          <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Data startu</div><input type="date" id="j-edit-start-date"></div>
          <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Taca/nazwa</div><input type="text" id="j-edit-tray-name"></div>
          <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Gatunek</div><select id="j-edit-species"><option value="CHICKEN">Kura</option><option value="DUCK">Kaczka</option><option value="GOOSE">Gęś</option><option value="QUAIL">Przepiórka</option><option value="GUINEA">Perliczka</option><option value="PHEASANT">Bażant</option></select></div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Rasa</div><input type="text" id="j-edit-breed"></div>
          <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Ilość jaj</div><input type="number" id="j-edit-egg-count" min="1" max="500" style="max-width:80px"></div>
          <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Uwagi</div><input type="text" id="j-edit-notes"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="vtbtn-group"><button class="vtbtn" onclick="saveEditedBatch()">✓ Zapisz zmiany</button></div>
      <div class="vmsg" id="j-edit-status"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="j-edit-note-panel" style="display:none">
    <div class="sec">Edycja wpisu dziennego</div>
    <div class="vtcard" style="border-color:rgba(167,139,250,.3)">
      <div class="vtcard-title">✎ Edytuj wpis <button class="vtbtn" onclick="cancelEditNote()" style="margin-left:auto">✕ Anuluj</button></div>
      <input type="hidden" id="j-edit-note-batch-id"><input type="hidden" id="j-edit-note-id">
      <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Dzień</div><input type="number" id="j-edit-note-day-edit" min="1" max="40" style="max-width:70px"></div>
      <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Notatka</div><textarea id="j-edit-note-text-edit" style="min-height:60px"></textarea></div>
      <div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Waga (g)</div><input type="number" id="j-edit-note-weight-edit" style="max-width:80px"></div>
      <div class="vtbtn-group">
        <button class="vtbtn" onclick="saveEditedNote()">✓ Zapisz</button>
        <button class="vtbtn vtbtn-danger" onclick="deleteEditingNote()">✗ Usuń</button>
      </div>
      <div class="vmsg" id="j-edit-note-status"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="sec">Aktywne lęgi</div>
  <div class="vtcard"><div id="j-active-list" class="journal-list"></div></div>

  <div class="sec">Statystyki sezonu</div>
  <div class="vtcard"><div id="j-stats" class="stat-grid"></div></div>

  <div class="sec">Porównanie tac</div>
  <div class="vtcard" style="overflow:auto">
    <table class="vt-table">
      <thead><tr><th>Taca</th><th>Zamknięte lęgi</th><th>Śr. % wylęgu</th><th>Najlepszy %</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody id="j-tray-compare"></tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <div class="sec">Archiwum lęgów · Filtry</div>
  <div class="vtcard" style="margin-bottom:8px">
    <div class="grid3">
      <div><div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--vt-muted);letter-spacing:.1em;margin-bottom:4px;text-transform:uppercase">Sezon</div><select id="j-filter-season" onchange="renderJournalArchive()"><option value="">Wszystkie</option></select></div>
      <div><div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--vt-muted);letter-spacing:.1em;margin-bottom:4px;text-transform:uppercase">Gatunek</div><select id="j-filter-species" onchange="renderJournalArchive()"><option value="">Wszystkie</option><option value="CHICKEN">Kura</option><option value="DUCK">Kaczka</option><option value="GOOSE">Gęś</option><option value="QUAIL">Przepiórka</option><option value="GUINEA">Perliczka</option><option value="PHEASANT">Bażant</option></select></div>
      <div><div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--vt-muted);letter-spacing:.1em;margin-bottom:4px;text-transform:uppercase">Status</div><select id="j-filter-status" onchange="renderJournalArchive()"><option value="">Wszystkie</option><option value="active">Aktywne</option><option value="completed">Zamknięte</option></select></div>
    </div>
    <div class="grid2" style="margin-top:8px">
      <div><div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--vt-muted);margin-bottom:4px">Rasa</div><input type="text" id="j-filter-breed" placeholder="np. leghorn" oninput="renderJournalArchive()"></div>
      <div><div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--vt-muted);margin-bottom:4px">Taca</div><input type="text" id="j-filter-tray" placeholder="np. taca 1" oninput="renderJournalArchive()"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="vtcard" style="overflow:auto">
    <table class="vt-table">
      <thead><tr><th>Data startu</th><th>Taca</th><th>Gatunek/rasa</th><th>Jaj</th><th>Wylęg</th><th>% wylęgu</th><th>% zapłodnienia</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody id="j-archive"></tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ===================== VIEW: SERWIS/ESP ===================== -->
<div id="view-serwis" class="view main">
  <div class="sec">Metryki ESP32</div>
  <div class="grid2">
    <div class="vtcard">
      <div class="vtcard-title">ESP32 · Stan systemu</div>
      <div class="esp-row"><span class="esp-key">Wolna RAM</span><span class="esp-val" id="esp-free-main">--</span></div>
      <div class="esp-row"><span class="esp-key">Użyta RAM</span><span class="esp-val" id="esp-used-main">--</span></div>
      <div class="esp-row"><span class="esp-key">Całość RAM</span><span class="esp-val" id="esp-total-main">--</span></div>
      <div class="esp-row"><span class="esp-key">PSRAM wolna</span><span class="esp-val" id="esp-psram-main">--</span></div>
      <div class="esp-row"><span class="esp-key">Temp. wewnętrzna</span><span class="esp-val" id="esp-temp-main">--</span></div>
      <div class="esp-row"><span class="esp-key">CPU</span><span class="esp-val" id="esp-cpu-main">--</span></div>
      <div class="esp-row"><span class="esp-key">Rdzenie</span><span class="esp-val" id="esp-cores-main">--</span></div>
      <div class="esp-row"><span class="esp-key">Wersja config</span><span class="esp-val" id="esp-cfgver-main">--</span></div>
      <div class="esp-row"><span class="esp-key">Tryb testowy</span><span class="esp-val" id="esp-testmode-main">--</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="vtcard">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Połączenia GPIO</div>
      <table class="vt-table">
        <thead><tr><th>Funkcja</th><th>GPIO</th><th>Uwagi</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td>DS18B20 #1</td><td><code>GPIO 6</code></td><td>1-Wire</td></tr>
          <tr><td>DS18B20 #2</td><td><code>GPIO 6</code></td><td>1-Wire wspólna</td></tr>
          <tr><td>DHT11</td><td><code>GPIO 8</code></td><td>Pull-up</td></tr>
          <tr><td>RTC DS3231 SDA</td><td><code>GPIO 4</code></td><td>I2C 0x68</td></tr>
          <tr><td>RTC DS3231 SCL</td><td><code>GPIO 5</code></td><td>I2C 0x68</td></tr>
          <tr><td>EEPROM AT24C32</td><td><code>GPIO 4/5</code></td><td>I2C 0x57</td></tr>
          <tr><td>BMP180 (opcj.)</td><td><code>GPIO 4/5</code></td><td>I2C 0x77 — wyłączony</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Grzałka CH0</td><td><code>GPIO 1</code></td><td>PWM</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Grzałka CH1</td><td><code>GPIO 2</code></td><td>PWM</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Taca 1</td><td><code>GPIO 16</code></td><td>PWM ruch</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Taca 2</td><td><code>GPIO 17</code></td><td>PWM ruch</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Taca 3 (rezerwa)</td><td><code>GPIO 18</code></td><td>PWM ruch</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Dyfuzor</td><td><code>GPIO 21</code></td><td>Manual/auto</td></tr>
          <tr><td style="color:var(--vt-red)">USB D-/D+ (NIE używać!)</td><td><code>GPIO 19/20</code></td><td style="color:var(--vt-red)">Zarezerwowane USB</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="sec">Okablowanie · Bezpieczniki</div>
  <div class="grid2">
    <div class="vtcard">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Okablowanie czujników</div>
      <table class="vt-table">
        <thead><tr><th>Obwód</th><th>Element</th><th>Wartość</th><th>Uwagi</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td>DS18B20</td><td>Pull-up</td><td><code>4.7kΩ</code></td><td>DATA↔3V3, blisko ESP</td></tr>
          <tr><td>DS18B20</td><td>Filtr</td><td><code>100nF</code></td><td>VDD↔GND, każdy czujnik</td></tr>
          <tr><td>DHT11</td><td>Pull-up</td><td><code>10kΩ</code></td><td>DATA↔3V3</td></tr>
          <tr><td>DHT11</td><td>Filtr zasilania</td><td><code>100nF+1uF</code></td><td>Przy pinach zasilania</td></tr>
          <tr><td>I2C DS3231</td><td>Pull-up SDA/SCL</td><td><code>4.7kΩ</code>×2</td><td>Często już na module</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Wejścia GPIO</td><td>Rezystor szeregowy</td><td><code>220Ω–1kΩ</code></td><td>Ochrona linii GPIO</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Linie >30cm</td><td>Filtr EMI</td><td><code>1–4.7nF</code></td><td>Do GND, tylko gdy zakłócenia</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
    <div class="vtcard">
      <div class="vtcard-title">Moc · Bezpieczniki</div>
      <table class="vt-table">
        <thead><tr><th>Sekcja</th><th>Zabezpieczenie</th><th>Wartość</th><th>Uwagi</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td>12V główne</td><td>Bezpiecznik</td><td><code>10A</code></td><td>Wejście zasilacza</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Grzałka CH0</td><td>Bezpiecznik</td><td><code>5A</code></td><td>Oddzielny kanał</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Grzałka CH1</td><td>Bezpiecznik</td><td><code>5A</code></td><td>Oddzielny kanał</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Dyfuzor</td><td>Bezpiecznik</td><td><code>2A</code></td><td>Wg poboru urządzenia</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Przekaźniki/silniki</td><td>Dioda flyback</td><td><code>1N4007</code></td><td>Równolegle do cewki</td></tr>
          <tr><td>MOSFET gate</td><td>Rezystor</td><td><code>100–220Ω</code></td><td>Ogranicza prąd przełączania</td></tr>
          <tr><td>MOSFET gate</td><td>Pull-down</td><td><code>100kΩ</code></td><td>Zapobiega przypadk. załączeniu</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="sec">Checklist serwisowy</div>
  <div class="vtcard">
    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px">
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--vt-muted);padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--vt-border)">1. Sprawdź wspólną masę: ESP, przekaźniki, zasilacz</div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--vt-muted);padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--vt-border)">2. Potwierdź I2C na <code>GPIO4/5</code> (RTC <code>0x68</code>, EEPROM <code>0x57</code>)</div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--vt-muted);padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--vt-border)">3. Nie używaj <code>GPIO19/20</code> — zarezerwowane USB D-/D+</div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--vt-muted);padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--vt-border)">4. BMP180 odłączony → wyłącz w konfiguracji, ignoruj brak <code>0x77</code></div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--vt-muted);padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--vt-border)">5. Sprawdź kierunek diod flyback (odwrotna polaryzacja = awaria)</div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--vt-muted);padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--vt-border)">6. Zmierz spadek napięcia na bezpiecznikach pod obciążeniem</div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--vt-muted);padding:5px 0">7. Przewody grzałek/dyfuzora prowadź osobno od linii czujników</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ===================== VIEW: LOGI ===================== -->
<div id="view-logi" class="view main">
  <div class="sec">Logi zdarzeń</div>
  <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px">
    <span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--vt-muted);letter-spacing:.06em"><span id="log-count">0</span> wpisów w sesji</span>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap">
      <select id="log-filter" onchange="renderEventLog()" style="max-width:160px">
        <option value="">Wszystkie typy</option>
        <option value="err">Błędy</option>
        <option value="warn">Ostrzeżenia</option>
        <option value="lockdown">Lockdown</option>
        <option value="cmd">Komendy</option>
        <option value="ok">OK</option>
        <option value="info">Info</option>
      </select>
      <button class="vtbtn" onclick="clearEventLog()">Wyczyść</button>
      <button class="vtbtn vtbtn-info" onclick="exportEventLogCSV()">Export CSV</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="vtcard" style="padding:8px">
    <div id="log-list" class="log-list"><div class="journal-empty">Brak logów. Pojawiają się po pierwszym połączeniu z API.</div></div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
// ============================================================
// STAŁE I STAN
// ============================================================
const DAY_MS=86400000;
const POWER_KEY='inkubator-power-v1';
const JOURNAL_STORAGE_KEY='inkubator_journal_v1';
const EVENT_LOG_MAX=200;
const RANGE_MS={"1h":3600000,"6h":21600000,"24h":86400000,"7d":604800000};
const RANGE_LABEL={"1h":"Ostatnia godzina","6h":"6 godzin","24h":"24 godziny","7d":"7 dni"};
const DETAIL_WINDOW_MS=45*60*1000;
const HI_DENSITY_WINDOW_MS=60*60*1000;
const RAW_RETENTION_MS=36*60*60*1000;
const MAX_RAW_POINTS=30000;
const MAX_RAW_POINTS_SAVE=20000;
const AGG_LEVELS=[
  {key:"m1",stepMs:60*1000,keepMs:8*24*60*60*1000},
  {key:"m5",stepMs:5*60*1000,keepMs:14*24*60*60*1000},
  {key:"m15",stepMs:15*60*1000,keepMs:30*24*60*60*1000},
  {key:"h1",stepMs:60*60*1000,keepMs:90*24*60*60*1000}
];
const SPECIES={
  CHICKEN:{days:21,lockdown:19,rows:d=>({tmin:d<18?37.5:37.2,tmax:d<18?37.8:37.5,hmin:d<19?45:65,hmax:d<19?55:75,turn:d<19,lockdown:d>=19,note:d===18?'Ostatni obrót':d===19?'LOCKDOWN – bez obrotów':''})},
  DUCK:{days:28,lockdown:25,rows:d=>({tmin:d<25?37.5:37.2,tmax:d<25?37.8:37.5,hmin:d<25?55:70,hmax:d<25?65:80,turn:d<25,lockdown:d>=25,note:d===24?'Ostatni obrót':d===25?'LOCKDOWN':''})},
  GOOSE:{days:30,lockdown:27,rows:d=>({tmin:d<27?37.4:37.2,tmax:d<27?37.8:37.5,hmin:d<27?55:70,hmax:d<27?65:80,turn:d<27,lockdown:d>=27,note:d===26?'Ostatni obrót':d===27?'LOCKDOWN':''})},
  QUAIL:{days:17,lockdown:15,rows:d=>({tmin:d<15?37.6:37.3,tmax:d<15?37.9:37.6,hmin:d<15?45:65,hmax:d<15?55:75,turn:d<15,lockdown:d>=15,note:d===14?'Ostatni obrót':d===15?'LOCKDOWN':''})},
  GUINEA:{days:26,lockdown:23,rows:d=>({tmin:d<23?37.5:37.2,tmax:d<23?37.8:37.5,hmin:d<23?50:65,hmax:d<23?60:75,turn:d<23,lockdown:d>=23,note:d===22?'Ostatni obrót':d===23?'LOCKDOWN':''})},
  PHEASANT:{days:24,lockdown:21,rows:d=>({tmin:d<21?37.5:37.2,tmax:d<21?37.8:37.5,hmin:d<21?50:65,hmax:d<21?60:75,turn:d<21,lockdown:d>=21,note:d===20?'Ostatni obrót':d===21?'LOCKDOWN':''})}
};

// Stan aplikacji
const state={
  tray:[{day:1,species:'CHICKEN'},{day:1,species:'CHICKEN'}],
  api:false,
  power:{heater:[true,true],tray:[true,true],diffuser:true},
  runtime:{heaterManual:[false,false],heaterPwm:[0,0],diffuserManual:false,diffuserOn:false}
};

// ============================================================
// LICZNIKI CZASU — NOWA IMPLEMENTACJA
// anchorMs = ms upłynięte w momencie ustawiania anchora
// anchorTs = Date.now() w momencie ustawiania anchora
// Anchor jest ustawiany TYLKO przy zmianie dnia lub pierwszym uruchomieniu
// co zapobiega cofaniu co 3s przy każdym fetchu
// ============================================================
const timers=[
  {anchorMs:0, anchorTs:0, day:0, total:21, species:'CHICKEN'},
  {anchorMs:0, anchorTs:0, day:0, total:21, species:'CHICKEN'}
];
// Flaga: czy timer jest aktywny (dostał pierwsze dane z API)
let timerActive=false;

function setTimerAnchor(i, day, species){
  const t=timers[i];
  const spD=SPECIES[species]||SPECIES.CHICKEN;
  // Jeśli dzień się nie zmienił i anchor jest już ustawiony — nie ruszamy
  if(t.day===day && t.anchorTs>0) return;
  t.day=day;
  t.total=spD.days;
  t.species=species;
  // Anchor = pełne dni (od początku inkubacji), czas w ciągu bieżącego dnia nieznany → 0
  t.anchorMs=(day-1)*DAY_MS;
  t.anchorTs=Date.now();
  timerActive=true;
}

function getElapsedMs(i){
  const t=timers[i];
  if(t.anchorTs===0) return (t.day-1)*DAY_MS;
  return Math.max(0, t.anchorMs + (Date.now()-t.anchorTs));
}

function formatDuration(ms){
  const safe=Math.max(0,Math.floor(ms));
  const d=Math.floor(safe/DAY_MS);
  const h=Math.floor((safe%DAY_MS)/3600000);
  const m=Math.floor((safe%3600000)/60000);
  const s=Math.floor((safe%60000)/1000);
  if(d>0) return d+'d '+h+'h '+m+'m '+s+'s';
  return h+'h '+m+'m '+s+'s';
}

function renderHatchTimers(){
  for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
    const t=timers[i];
    const elapsed=getElapsedMs(i);
    const totalMs=t.total*DAY_MS;
    const remaining=Math.max(0,totalMs-elapsed);
    const pct=Math.min(100,Math.round(elapsed/totalMs*100));
    const spN=shortSpecies(t.species);
    const spD=SPECIES[t.species]||SPECIES.CHICKEN;
    const isLock=t.day>=spD.lockdown;
    const phaseColor=t.day>t.total?'var(--vt-red)':isLock?'var(--vt-purple)':(t.total-t.day<=2?'var(--vt-amber)':'var(--vt-green)');
    const phase=t.day>t.total?'PRZETERMINOWANY':isLock?'KLUCIE':(t.total-t.day<=2?'WKRÓTCE':'INKUBACJA');

    // Statusowa zakładka
    setText('hatch-title'+i,'TACA '+(i+1)+' · '+spN.toUpperCase());
    setText('hatch-dayline'+i,'Dzień '+t.day+' z '+t.total+' · '+pct+'%');
    setText('hatch-elapsed'+i,formatDuration(elapsed));
    setText('hatch-remaining'+i,remaining===0?'🐣 WYLĘG!':('-'+formatDuration(remaining)));

    // Panel sterowania (duplikaty)
    const ep=document.getElementById('hatch-elapsed'+i+'p');
    const rp=document.getElementById('hatch-remaining'+i+'p');
    const tp=document.getElementById('hatch-title'+i+'p');
    const dp=document.getElementById('hatch-dayline'+i+'p');
    if(ep) ep.textContent=formatDuration(elapsed);
    if(rp) rp.textContent=remaining===0?'🐣 WYLĘG!':('-'+formatDuration(remaining));
    if(tp) tp.textContent='TACA '+(i+1)+' · '+spN.toUpperCase();
    if(dp) dp.textContent='Dzień '+t.day+' z '+t.total+' · '+pct+'%';

    // Pip-Boy tray info
    const info=document.getElementById('pip-tray'+i+'-info');
    if(info) info.textContent=spN.toUpperCase()+' · D'+t.day+'/'+t.total+' · '+pct+'%';
    const phaseEl=document.getElementById('pip-tray'+i+'-phase');
    if(phaseEl){phaseEl.textContent=phase;phaseEl.style.color=phaseColor;}
  }

  // Aktualizuj wskaźnik timera
  const timerStatusEl=document.getElementById('timerStatus');
  const timerDotEl=document.getElementById('timerActiveDot');
  const rtcLabel=document.getElementById('rtcStatusLabel');
  if(timerActive){
    if(timerStatusEl){timerStatusEl.textContent='AKTYWNY';timerStatusEl.className='tb-stat-val';}
    if(timerDotEl) timerDotEl.className='dot6 ok';
    if(rtcLabel) rtcLabel.textContent='RTC TIMER: AKTYWNY';
  } else {
    if(timerStatusEl){timerStatusEl.textContent='CZEKA';timerStatusEl.className='tb-stat-val warn';}
    if(timerDotEl) timerDotEl.className='dot6 warn';
    if(rtcLabel) rtcLabel.textContent='RTC TIMER: CZEKA NA DANE';
  }
}

// ============================================================
// TACHOMETER GAUGE (PÓŁOKRĄG — wartość NA DOLE jak tachometr)
// ============================================================
function drawTacho(canvasId, val, min, max, okMin, okMax, unit, compact){
  const c=document.getElementById(canvasId);
  if(!c)return;
  const ctx=c.getContext('2d');
  const dpr=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
  const W=c.width/dpr;
  const H=c.height/dpr;
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);

  const cx=W/2;
  const cy=H*0.92; // Środek łuku bardzo nisko → płaski, szeroki półokrąg jak tachometr
  const R=Math.min(W*0.46, H*0.88);
  const SA=Math.PI*1.0; // Start: lewa strona (180°)
  const EA=Math.PI*2.0; // End: prawa strona (360°)
  const SP=EA-SA;

  function toAngle(v){
    return SA+SP*Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(v-min)/(max-min)));
  }

  // Tło łuku (szary)
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx,cy,R,SA,EA);
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(57,211,95,.08)';
  ctx.lineWidth=compact?10:14;
  ctx.lineCap='butt';
  ctx.stroke();

  // Strefy kolorów
  const zones=[
    {from:min, to:Math.max(min,okMin-(okMax-okMin)*0.5), color:'rgba(239,68,68,.5)'},
    {from:Math.max(min,okMin-(okMax-okMin)*0.5), to:okMin, color:'rgba(234,179,8,.55)'},
    {from:okMin, to:okMax, color:'rgba(57,211,95,.85)'},
    {from:okMax, to:Math.min(max,okMax+(okMax-okMin)*0.5), color:'rgba(234,179,8,.55)'},
    {from:Math.min(max,okMax+(okMax-okMin)*0.5), to:max, color:'rgba(239,68,68,.5)'},
  ];
  ctx.lineWidth=compact?10:14;
  ctx.lineCap='butt';
  for(const z of zones){
    if(z.from>=z.to) continue;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx,cy,R,toAngle(z.from),toAngle(z.to));
    ctx.strokeStyle=z.color;
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Znaczniki podziałki
  const steps=10;
  for(let i=0;i<=steps;i++){
    const a=SA+(SP/steps)*i;
    const major=i%2===0;
    const len=major?(compact?8:10):(compact?4:6);
    const r0=R-(compact?14:20);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx+Math.cos(a)*(R-len),cy+Math.sin(a)*(R-len));
    ctx.lineTo(cx+Math.cos(a)*(R+2),cy+Math.sin(a)*(R+2));
    ctx.strokeStyle=major?'rgba(57,211,95,.6)':'rgba(57,211,95,.25)';
    ctx.lineWidth=major?1.5:1;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Etykiety tylko na skrajnych i środku
    if((i===0||i===5||i===steps)&&major&&!compact){
      const lv=(min+(max-min)*(i/steps)).toFixed(0);
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(57,211,95,.45)';
      ctx.font=`9px 'Share Tech Mono',monospace`;
      ctx.textAlign='center';
      ctx.textBaseline='middle';
      ctx.fillText(lv,cx+Math.cos(a)*(R+14),cy+Math.sin(a)*(R+14));
    }
  }

  // Wskazówka
  const nv=(val!=null&&isFinite(val))?Number(val):min;
  const na=toAngle(Math.max(min,Math.min(max,nv)));
  const ok=nv>=okMin&&nv<=okMax;
  const nc=ok?'#39d35f':(nv>okMax+(okMax-okMin)||nv<okMin-(okMax-okMin))?'#ef4444':'#eab308';

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(cx,cy);
  ctx.rotate(na);
  ctx.shadowColor=nc;
  ctx.shadowBlur=10;
  ctx.fillStyle=nc;
  const needleLen=R-8;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-8,0);
  ctx.lineTo(needleLen,3);
  ctx.lineTo(needleLen,-3);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;

  // Centralny punkt
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx,cy,compact?5:7,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fillStyle='#060d06';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx,cy,compact?3:4,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fillStyle=nc;
  ctx.shadowColor=nc;
  ctx.shadowBlur=6;
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
}

// ============================================================
// INCUBATION RING
// ============================================================
function drawIncubationRing(canvasId,day,totalDays,lockdownDay){
  const c=document.getElementById(canvasId);if(!c)return;
  const ctx=c.getContext('2d');
  const dpr=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
  const W=c.width/dpr, H=c.height/dpr;
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,W);
  const cx=W/2,cy=H/2,R=W*0.39,lw=Math.max(7,W*0.072);
  const SA=-Math.PI/2;
  const prog=totalDays>1?Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(day-1)/(totalDays-1))):0;
  const isLock=!!(lockdownDay&&day>=lockdownDay);
  const isOver=day>totalDays;
  const isNear=!isLock&&totalDays-day<=2;
  const fc=isOver?'#ef4444':isLock?'#a78bfa':isNear?'#f5a623':'#39d35f';

  // Tło pierścienia
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(57,211,95,.07)';ctx.lineWidth=lw;ctx.lineCap='butt';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,R,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();

  // Wypełnienie postępu
  if(prog>0){
    ctx.strokeStyle=fc;ctx.lineWidth=lw;ctx.lineCap='round';
    ctx.shadowColor=fc;ctx.shadowBlur=8;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,R,SA,SA+prog*Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  }

  // Marker lockdownu
  if(lockdownDay&&lockdownDay<totalDays){
    const lA=SA+((lockdownDay-1)/(totalDays-1))*Math.PI*2;
    ctx.strokeStyle='#a78bfa';ctx.lineWidth=2.5;ctx.lineCap='round';
    ctx.shadowColor='#a78bfa';ctx.shadowBlur=6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx+Math.cos(lA)*(R-lw),cy+Math.sin(lA)*(R-lw));
    ctx.lineTo(cx+Math.cos(lA)*(R+lw),cy+Math.sin(lA)*(R+lw));
    ctx.stroke();ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  }

  // Cyfry dnia
  ctx.fillStyle=fc;ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.font=`500 ${Math.round(W*0.22)}px 'Share Tech Mono',monospace`;
  ctx.shadowColor=fc;ctx.shadowBlur=10;
  ctx.fillText(day>0?day:'--',cx,cy-W*0.06);ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(200,232,200,.45)';
  ctx.font=`${Math.round(W*0.055)}px 'Share Tech Mono',monospace`;
  ctx.fillText('/'+totalDays,cx,cy+W*0.075);

  // Faza
  const phaseText=isOver?'PRZETERMINOWANY':isLock?'KLUCIE':isNear?'WKRÓTCE':'INKUBACJA';
  ctx.fillStyle=fc;ctx.font=`bold ${Math.round(W*0.044)}px 'Oswald',sans-serif`;
  ctx.shadowColor=fc;ctx.shadowBlur=5;
  ctx.fillText(phaseText,cx,cy+W*0.165);ctx.shadowBlur=0;
}

// ============================================================
// UTILS
// ============================================================
function isF(v){return Number.isFinite(v)&&v>-100}
function setText(id,v){const e=document.getElementById(id);if(e)e.textContent=v}
function setMsg(el,type,text){if(!el)return;el.textContent=text;el.className='vmsg '+(type||'')}
function todayStr(){return new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}
function asNum(v){const n=Number(v);return Number.isFinite(n)?n:0}
function shortSpecies(v){return{CHICKEN:'Kura',DUCK:'Kaczka',GOOSE:'Gęś',QUAIL:'Przepiórka',GUINEA:'Perliczka',PHEASANT:'Bażant'}[v]||v}
function speciesDays(s){return(SPECIES[s]?.days)||21}
function calcEstimatedHatchDate(startDate,species){
  if(!startDate)return'--';
  const d=new Date(startDate+'T00:00:00');
  if(Number.isNaN(d.getTime()))return'--';
  d.setDate(d.getDate()+speciesDays(species));
  return d.toISOString().slice(0,10);
}
function calcIncubationDay(startDate,dateRef){
  if(!startDate)return null;
  const a=new Date(startDate+'T00:00:00');
  const b=new Date((dateRef||todayStr())+'T00:00:00');
  if(Number.isNaN(a.getTime())||Number.isNaN(b.getTime()))return null;
  return Math.max(1,Math.floor((b-a)/86400000)+1);
}
function calcHatchPercent(batch){
  const eggs=Math.max(1,asNum(batch.eggCount));
  const hatched=asNum(batch.summary?.hatchedHealthy)+asNum(batch.summary?.hatchedWeak);
  return(hatched/eggs)*100;
}
function calcFertilityPercent(batch){
  const eggs=Math.max(1,asNum(batch.eggCount));
  if(batch.candling?.fertile==null)return null;
  return(asNum(batch.candling.fertile)/eggs)*100;
}

// ============================================================
// API + FETCH
// ============================================================
let fetching=false;let abortCtrl=null;

async function fetchData(){
  if(fetching)return;fetching=true;
  if(abortCtrl)abortCtrl.abort();
  abortCtrl=new AbortController();
  const sig=abortCtrl.signal;
  try{
    const[sRes,tRes]=await Promise.all([fetch('/api/status',{signal:sig}),fetch('/api/trays',{signal:sig})]);
    const s=await sRes.json(),t=await tRes.json();
    updateAll(s,t);
  }catch(e){
    if(e.name!=='AbortError'){
      if(state.api===true)logEvent('err','Utracono połączenie: '+(e.message||'błąd'));
      setApiStatus(false);
    }
  }finally{fetching=false;}
}

function setApiStatus(ok){
  const dot=document.getElementById('apiDot'),txt=document.getElementById('apiStatusTop');
  if(dot)dot.className='dot6 '+(ok?'ok':'err');
  if(txt)txt.textContent=ok?'OK':'BRAK';
  state.api=ok;
}

function updateAll(s,t){
  setApiStatus(true);
  chartState.lastStatus=s;

  // Uptime
  const ms=s.uptime_ms||0;
  const hh=Math.floor(ms/3600000),mm=Math.floor((ms%3600000)/60000),ss=Math.floor((ms%60000)/1000);
  setText('uptimeTop',[hh,mm,ss].map(v=>String(v).padStart(2,'0')).join(':'));

  // Temperatury i wilgotność
  const t0=s.temp_chamber,t1=s.temp_aquarium,hum=s.humidity;
  const tgt=s.target_temp,hMin=s.humidity_target_min||45,hMax=s.humidity_target_max||65;
  const now=Date.now();
  addHistorySample('temp_chamber',t0,now);
  addHistorySample('temp_aquarium',t1,now);
  addHistorySample('humidity',hum,now);

  // Zaktualizuj wyświetlacze gauges — Status
  updateGaugeDisplay('pip-temp','disp-temp0-big',t0,tgt,tgt-0.5,tgt+0.5,0,42,'°C',false);
  updateGaugeDisplay('pip-hum','disp-hum-big',hum,null,hMin,hMax,30,90,'%',false);
  updateGaugeDisplay('pip-temp1','disp-temp1-big',t1,tgt,tgt-0.5,tgt+0.5,0,42,'°C',false);
  // Panel
  updateGaugeDisplay('p-temp0','disp-temp0',t0,tgt,tgt-0.5,tgt+0.5,0,42,'°C',true);
  updateGaugeDisplay('p-temp1','disp-temp1',t1,tgt,tgt-0.5,tgt+0.5,0,42,'°C',true);
  updateGaugeDisplay('p-hum','disp-hum',hum,null,hMin,hMax,30,90,'%',true);

  setText('disp-target',isF(tgt)?tgt.toFixed(1)+' °C':'--');
  setText('disp-hum-range',hMin+'–'+hMax+' %');

  // Grzałki
  const pwm0=isF(s.heater_pwm_ch0)?s.heater_pwm_ch0:(isF(s.heater_pwm)?s.heater_pwm:0);
  const pwm1=isF(s.heater_pwm_ch1)?s.heater_pwm_ch1:(isF(s.heater_pwm)?s.heater_pwm:0);
  updateHeater(0,pwm0,!!s.heater_manual_ch0);
  updateHeater(1,pwm1,!!s.heater_manual_ch1);

  // Tace
  const trays=t.trays||[];
  deviceState.trays=trays;
  for(let i=0;i<2;i++) updateTrayUI(i,trays[i]||{});

  // Dyfuzor
  updateDiffuserUI(!!s.diffuser_on,!!s.diffuser_manual_mode);

  // ESP
  if(s.esp_free_heap!=null){
    setText('esp-free-main',(s.esp_free_heap/1024).toFixed(0)+' KB');
    setText('esp-used-main',(((s.esp_total_heap||0)-s.esp_free_heap)/1024).toFixed(0)+' KB');
    setText('esp-total-main',((s.esp_total_heap||0)/1024).toFixed(0)+' KB');
    setText('esp-psram-main',s.esp_free_psram!=null?(s.esp_free_psram/1024).toFixed(0)+' KB':'N/A');
  }
  if(s.esp_internal_temp!=null){
    const et=s.esp_internal_temp;
    setText('esp-temp-main',et.toFixed(1)+' °C');
    const el=document.getElementById('espTempTop');
    if(el){el.textContent=et.toFixed(1)+'°C';el.className='tb-stat-val '+(et>=65?'danger':et>=55?'warn':'');}
    const dot=document.getElementById('espDot');
    if(dot)dot.className='dot6 '+(et>=65?'err':et>=55?'warn':'ok');
  }
  if(s.esp_cpu_freq_mhz!=null)setText('esp-cpu-main',s.esp_cpu_freq_mhz+' MHz');
  if(s.esp_chip_cores!=null)setText('esp-cores-main',s.esp_chip_cores);
  setText('esp-cfgver-main',s.config_version||'--');
  setText('esp-testmode-main',s.test_mode?'TAK':'NIE');

  updateAlerts(s);
  updateTopBadges(s);
  updateTopTrays();
  updateLockdownPreview();
  syncMainControls(s,trays);
  updatePowerIndicators();
  renderHistoryPanelsDeb();

  // Pierścienie tac
  for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
    const tray=trays[i]||{};
    const day=tray.current_day||state.tray[i].day||1;
    const sp=document.getElementById('main-species-tray'+i)?.value||tray.species||'CHICKEN';
    const spD=SPECIES[sp]||SPECIES.CHICKEN;
    drawIncubationRing('pip-tray'+i,day,spD.days,spD.lockdown);
  }
}

function updateGaugeDisplay(canvasId, dispId, val, tgt, okMin, okMax, lo, hi, unit, compact){
  // Rysuj tachometr
  drawTacho(canvasId, val, lo, hi, okMin, okMax, unit, !!compact);
  // Aktualizuj cyfrowy wyświetlacz poniżej
  const el=document.getElementById(dispId);
  if(!el)return;
  const v=isF(val)?val.toFixed(1):'--';
  const ok=isF(val)&&val>=okMin&&val<=okMax;
  const hot=isF(val)&&val>okMax+(okMax-okMin);
  const cold=isF(val)&&val<okMin-(okMax-okMin);
  const cls=ok?'':'warn';
  el.innerHTML=v+'<span class="gauge-unit">'+unit+'</span>';
  el.className='gauge-label-below '+(hot||cold?'hot':(!ok?'warn':''));
}

function updateTrayUI(i,tr){
  const day=tr.current_day||state.tray[i].day||1;
  state.tray[i].day=day;

  const speciesId=tr.species||tr.species_id||document.getElementById('main-species-tray'+i)?.value||'CHICKEN';

  // Ustaw anchor tylko jeśli dzień się zmienił
  setTimerAnchor(i, day, speciesId);

  const summary=document.getElementById('main-tray'+i+'-summary');
  if(summary)summary.textContent='Ostatni obrót: '+fmtRot(tr);

  const badge=document.getElementById('badge-tray'+i+'-species');
  const speciesSel=document.getElementById('main-species-tray'+i);
  if(speciesSel)speciesSel.value=speciesId;
  if(badge)badge.textContent=shortSpecies(speciesId);

  state.tray[i].species=speciesId;

  const ind=document.getElementById('ind-tray'+i);
  if(ind){
    const isMoving=!!tr.moving||!!tr.is_rotating;
    const isActive=!!tr.active;
    ind.className='dev-dot'+(isMoving?' warn':isActive?' on':'');
  }
}

function updateHeater(ch,pwm,manual){
  const val=isF(pwm)?pwm:0;
  const dispEl=document.getElementById('disp-main-pwm'+ch);
  if(dispEl)dispEl.innerHTML=Math.round(val)+'<span style="font-size:18px;color:var(--vt-muted)">%</span>';
  const pill=document.getElementById('pill-main-h'+ch);
  if(pill){pill.textContent=manual?'RĘCZNY':'AUTO';pill.className='mpill '+(manual?'manual':'auto');}
  const sl=document.getElementById('sl-main-h'+ch);
  if(sl&&!manual){sl.value=Math.round(val);setText('sv-main-h'+ch,Math.round(val)+'%');}
  state.runtime.heaterManual[ch]=!!manual;
  state.runtime.heaterPwm[ch]=val;
  updateHeaterDots(ch,val);
}

function updateHeaterDots(ch,pwm){
  const dot=document.getElementById('ind-heat'+ch);
  if(dot)dot.className='dev-dot'+(state.power.heater[ch]&&pwm>0.5?' on':'');
  setText('disp-main-pwm'+ch+'-mini',Math.round(pwm||0)+'%');
  // Status pip
  const vd=document.getElementById('dot-h'+ch);
  if(vd)vd.className='dev-dot'+(state.power.heater[ch]&&pwm>0.5?' on':'');
  const vv=document.getElementById('pip-heater'+ch+'-val');
  if(vv)vv.textContent=Math.round(pwm||0)+'%';
}

function updateDiffuserUI(on,manual){
  const ind=document.getElementById('ind-diff');
  if(ind)ind.className='dev-dot'+(on?' on':'');
  const txt=document.getElementById('txt-diff');
  if(txt){txt.textContent=on?'PRACUJE':'STOP';txt.style.color=on?'var(--vt-green)':'var(--vt-muted)';}
  const pill=document.getElementById('pill-diff');
  if(pill){pill.textContent=manual?'RĘCZNY':'AUTO';pill.className='mpill '+(manual?'manual':'auto');}
  const pv=document.getElementById('pip-diff-val');
  if(pv)pv.textContent=on?'PRACUJE':'STOP';
  state.runtime.diffuserOn=!!on;state.runtime.diffuserManual=!!manual;
}

function updateAlerts(s){
  const alerts=[];
  const t=s.temp_chamber,tgt=s.target_temp;
  if(isF(t)&&isF(tgt)&&Math.abs(t-tgt)>=1.5)alerts.push({type:'hot',msg:'Temperatura odbiega od celu o >= 1.5°C'});
  if(isF(t)&&t>=40.5)alerts.push({type:'hot',msg:'RYZYKO PRZEGRZANIA (>= 40.5°C)'});
  if(isF(s.humidity)&&s.humidity<45)alerts.push({type:'warn',msg:'Niska wilgotność (<45%)'});
  if(s.esp_internal_temp!=null&&s.esp_internal_temp>=65)alerts.push({type:'warn',msg:'Wysoka temp. ESP (>= 65°C)'});
  const box=document.getElementById('alerts-box');
  if(!box)return;
  if(!alerts.length){box.innerHTML='<div style="font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--vt-muted)">Brak aktywnych alarmów</div>';return;}
  box.innerHTML=alerts.map(a=>`<div class="alert-row ${a.type}">▶ ${a.msg}</div>`).join('');
}

function updateTopBadges(s){
  const badges=[];
  if(isF(s.temp_chamber)&&isF(s.target_temp)){
    const diff=Math.abs(s.temp_chamber-s.target_temp);
    if(diff>1)badges.push(`<span class="vtbadge vtbadge-warn">TEMP ±${diff.toFixed(1)}°C</span>`);
    if(s.temp_chamber>40.5)badges.push(`<span class="vtbadge vtbadge-hot">PRZEGRZANIE</span>`);
  }
  if(s.diffuser_on)badges.push(`<span class="vtbadge vtbadge-info">DYFUZOR ON</span>`);
  if(s.test_mode)badges.push(`<span class="vtbadge vtbadge-warn">TEST MODE</span>`);
  for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
    const sp=state.tray[i].species||'CHICKEN';
    const day=state.tray[i].day||1;
    const totalD=speciesDays(sp),lockD=SPECIES[sp]?.lockdown||totalD;
    const remain=totalD-day,isLock=day>=lockD;
    if(isLock)badges.push(`<span class="vtbadge vtbadge-lock">LOCKDOWN T${i+1}</span>`);
    if(day>=7&&day<=10)badges.push(`<span class="vtbadge vtbadge-info">T${i+1}: OVOSKOPIA</span>`);
    if(remain===1||remain===2)badges.push(`<span class="vtbadge vtbadge-ok">T${i+1}: 🐣 za ${remain}d</span>`);
    if(remain<=0&&remain>-3)badges.push(`<span class="vtbadge vtbadge-ok">T${i+1}: 🐣 WYLĘG!</span>`);
  }
  document.getElementById('topbarBadges').innerHTML=badges.join('');
}

function updateTopTrays(){
  const el=document.getElementById('topbar-trays');
  if(!el)return;
  const chips=[];
  for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
    const sp=state.tray[i].species||'CHICKEN';
    const day=state.tray[i].day||1;
    const totalDays=speciesDays(sp),lockDay=SPECIES[sp]?.lockdown||totalDays;
    const isLock=day>=lockDay,remain=totalDays-day,isHatch=remain<=0;
    const chipCls=isHatch?' hatch':isLock?' lockdown':'';
    const remainStr=isHatch?'🐣 WYLĘG':isLock?'LOCK':(remain<=2?'🐣 '+remain+'d':remain+'d');
    chips.push(`<div class="tray-chip${chipCls}">T${i+1}:${shortSpecies(sp).substring(0,3).toUpperCase()} D${day}/${totalDays} ·${remainStr}</div>`);
  }
  el.innerHTML=chips.join('');
}

function updateLockdownPreview(){
  const el=document.getElementById('lockdown-tray-preview');
  if(!el)return;
  const lines=[];
  for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
    const sp=document.getElementById('main-species-tray'+i)?.value||'CHICKEN';
    const lockDay=SPECIES[sp]?.lockdown||speciesDays(sp);
    const day=state.tray[i].day||1;
    const isLock=day>=lockDay;
    lines.push(`T${i+1}: ${shortSpecies(sp)} · dzień ${day} → lockdown D${lockDay}${isLock?' <span style="color:var(--vt-purple)">(aktywny)</span>':`<span style="color:var(--vt-muted)"> (za ${lockDay-day}d)</span>`}`);
  }
  el.innerHTML=lines.join('<br>');
}

function updatePowerIndicators(){
  for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
    const on=!!state.power.heater[i];
    const swPanel=document.getElementById('sw-main-h'+i);
    const swPip=document.getElementById('sw-pip-h'+i);
    if(swPanel)swPanel.checked=on;
    if(swPip)swPip.checked=on;
    updateHeaterDots(i,state.runtime.heaterPwm[i]||0);

    const tOn=!!state.power.tray[i];
    const stPanel=document.getElementById('sw-tray'+i);
    const stPip=document.getElementById('sw-pip-tray'+i);
    if(stPanel)stPanel.checked=tOn;
    if(stPip)stPip.checked=tOn;
  }
  const dOn=!!state.power.diffuser;
  const diffPanel=document.getElementById('sw-diff');
  const diffPip=document.getElementById('sw-pip-diff');
  if(diffPanel)diffPanel.checked=dOn;
  if(diffPip)diffPip.checked=dOn;
  const diffDot=document.getElementById('dot-diff');
  if(diffDot)diffDot.className='dev-dot'+(dOn?' on':'');
}

function syncMainControls(s,trays){
  for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
    const tray=trays[i]||{};
    const species=tray.species||state.tray[i].species||'CHICKEN';
    const day=tray.current_day||state.tray[i].day||1;
    const speciesMain=document.getElementById('main-species-tray'+i);
    const dayMain=document.getElementById('main-day-tray'+i);
    if(speciesMain)speciesMain.value=species;
    if(dayMain)dayMain.value=day;
    const schedBadge=document.getElementById('main-sched-badge'+i);
    if(schedBadge)schedBadge.textContent=shortSpecies(species)+' · D'+day;
    const schedMain=document.getElementById('sched-species'+i);
    if(schedMain)schedMain.value=species;
    const durMain=document.getElementById('main-dur-tray'+i);
    const spdMain=document.getElementById('main-spd-tray'+i);
    if(durMain&&!durMain.value)durMain.value=15000;
    if(spdMain&&!spdMain.value)spdMain.value=102;
    if(tray.last_rotation_day!=null){
      const summary=document.getElementById('main-tray'+i+'-summary');
      if(summary)summary.textContent='Ostatni obrót: '+fmtRot(tray);
    }
  }
}

function fmtRot(tray){if(!tray||!tray.has_last_rotation)return'brak';const h=String(tray.last_rotation_hour||0).padStart(2,'0'),m=String(tray.last_rotation_minute||0).padStart(2,'0');return'Dzień '+(tray.last_rotation_day||0)+', '+h+':'+m;}

// ============================================================
// HISTORIA I WYKRESY
// ============================================================
function createMetricStore(){return{raw:[],agg:{m1:[],m5:[],m15:[],h1:[]}};}
const historyStore={temp_chamber:createMetricStore(),temp_aquarium:createMetricStore(),humidity:createMetricStore()};
const chartState={tempRange:"1h",humRange:"1h",memorySaving:false,lastStatus:null,showBands:true};
const deviceState={trays:[]};

function addHistorySample(metric,value,ts){
  if(!isF(value))return;
  const store=historyStore[metric];if(!store)return;
  store.raw.push({ts,v:value});
  pruneRaw(store.raw,ts);
  for(const level of AGG_LEVELS){
    upsertAggregate(store.agg[level.key],value,ts,level.stepMs);
    pruneAggregate(store.agg[level.key],ts-level.keepMs);
  }
}
function pruneRaw(arr,nowTs){
  const cap=chartState.memorySaving?MAX_RAW_POINTS_SAVE:MAX_RAW_POINTS;
  const minTs=nowTs-RAW_RETENTION_MS;
  while(arr.length&&arr[0].ts<minTs)arr.shift();
  while(arr.length>cap)arr.shift();
}
function upsertAggregate(arr,value,ts,stepMs){
  const bucketTs=Math.floor(ts/stepMs)*stepMs;
  const last=arr[arr.length-1];
  if(last&&last.ts===bucketTs){last.min=Math.min(last.min,value);last.max=Math.max(last.max,value);last.sum+=value;last.count+=1;last.avg=last.sum/last.count;return;}
  arr.push({ts:bucketTs,min:value,max:value,sum:value,count:1,avg:value});
}
function pruneAggregate(arr,minTs){while(arr.length&&arr[0].ts<minTs)arr.shift();}

let renderHistoryPanelsTimeout;
function renderHistoryPanelsDeb(){
  clearTimeout(renderHistoryPanelsTimeout);
  renderHistoryPanelsTimeout=setTimeout(()=>{
    const pv=document.getElementById('view-panel');
    if(pv&&pv.classList.contains('active'))renderHistoryPanels();
  },800);
}

function setChartRange(metric,range){
  if(!RANGE_MS[range])return;
  if(metric==='temp')chartState.tempRange=range;else chartState.humRange=range;
  document.querySelectorAll('.chart-tab[data-metric="'+metric+'"]').forEach(el=>el.classList.toggle('active',el.dataset.range===range));
  const captId=metric==='temp'?'chart-temp-caption':'chart-hum-caption';
  setText(captId,RANGE_LABEL[range]);
  renderHistoryPanelsDeb();
}

function selectAggKey(range){if(range==='6h')return'm1';if(range==='24h')return'm5';if(range==='7d')return'h1';return null;}
function downsample(points,maxPoints){if(points.length<=maxPoints)return points;const step=(points.length-1)/(maxPoints-1);const out=[];for(let i=0;i<maxPoints;i++)out.push(points[Math.round(i*step)]);return out;}

function getMainSeries(metric,range){
  const store=historyStore[metric];if(!store)return[];
  const now=Date.now();const from=now-RANGE_MS[range];
  if(range==='1h'){const pts=store.raw.filter(p=>p.ts>=from);return pts.length<2?[]:downsample(pts,900);}
  const denseFrom=Math.max(from,now-HI_DENSITY_WINDOW_MS);
  const aggKey=selectAggKey(range);
  const older=aggKey?store.agg[aggKey].filter(p=>p.ts>=from&&p.ts<denseFrom).map(p=>({ts:p.ts,v:p.avg})):[];
  const recent=store.raw.filter(p=>p.ts>=denseFrom);
  const all=older.concat(recent);
  return all.length<2?[]:downsample(all,1200);
}
function getDetailSeries(metric){
  const store=historyStore[metric];if(!store)return[];
  const from=Date.now()-DETAIL_WINDOW_MS;
  const pts=store.raw.filter(p=>p.ts>=from);
  return pts.length<2?[]:downsample(pts,1000);
}
function getBands(metric,status){
  if(!status)return null;
  if(metric==='temp_chamber'){if(!isF(status.target_temp))return null;const mid=status.target_temp;return{targetMin:mid-0.3,targetMax:mid+0.3,alarmMin:mid-1.5,alarmMax:mid+1.5};}
  if(metric==='humidity'){const targetMin=isF(status.humidity_target_min)?status.humidity_target_min:45;const targetMax=isF(status.humidity_target_max)?status.humidity_target_max:65;return{targetMin,targetMax,alarmMin:Math.max(20,targetMin-12),alarmMax:Math.min(95,targetMax+12)};}
  return null;
}

function drawHistoryChart(canvasId,points,opt){
  const el=document.getElementById(canvasId);if(!el)return;
  const ctx=el.getContext('2d');
  const dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1;
  const w=Math.max(260,Math.floor(el.clientWidth||el.offsetWidth||260));
  const h=Math.max(60,Math.floor(el.clientHeight||100));
  if(el.width!==Math.floor(w*dpr)||el.height!==Math.floor(h*dpr)){el.width=Math.floor(w*dpr);el.height=Math.floor(h*dpr);}
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
  const pad=10,plotW=w-2*pad,plotH=h-2*pad;
  if(!points||points.length<2){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(200,232,200,.3)';ctx.font='10px Share Tech Mono';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('Czekanie na dane...',Math.floor(w/2),Math.floor(h/2));ctx.textAlign='left';return;}
  const values=points.map(p=>p.v).filter(isF);if(!values.length)return;
  let lo=Math.min(...values),hi=Math.max(...values);
  if(!isFinite(lo)||!isFinite(hi))return;
  if(opt.bands){const b=opt.bands;const wb=[b.targetMin,b.targetMax,b.alarmMin,b.alarmMax].filter(isF);if(wb.length){lo=Math.min(lo,...wb);hi=Math.max(hi,...wb);}}
  const span=Math.max(0.5,hi-lo);const margin=Math.max(span*.15,opt.metric==='humidity'?2:0.3);lo-=margin;hi+=margin;
  const tMin=points[0].ts,tMax=Math.max(points[points.length-1].ts,tMin+1);
  const mapX=ts=>pad+((ts-tMin)/(tMax-tMin))*plotW;
  const mapY=v=>pad+plotH-((v-lo)/(hi-lo))*plotH;
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const y=pad+(plotH/3)*i;ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(57,211,95,.08)';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pad,y);ctx.lineTo(w-pad,y);ctx.stroke();}
  if(opt.bands&&chartState.showBands){
    const b=opt.bands;
    const drawBand=(v1,v2,color)=>{if(!isF(v1)||!isF(v2))return;const yTop=mapY(Math.max(v1,v2));const yBot=mapY(Math.min(v1,v2));ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.fillRect(pad,yTop,plotW,Math.max(1,yBot-yTop));};
    drawBand(b.alarmMin,b.alarmMax,'rgba(239,68,68,.06)');
    drawBand(b.targetMin,b.targetMax,'rgba(57,211,95,.15)');
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(57,211,95,.4)';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.setLineDash([3,3]);
    const mid=(b.targetMin+b.targetMax)/2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pad,mapY(mid));ctx.lineTo(w-pad,mapY(mid));ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);
  }
  ctx.beginPath();points.forEach((p,i)=>{const x=mapX(p.ts),y=mapY(p.v);if(i===0)ctx.moveTo(x,y);else ctx.lineTo(x,y);});
  ctx.strokeStyle='#7dd3fc';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.stroke();
  const latest=points[points.length-1]?.v;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(200,232,200,.7)';ctx.font='bold 10px Share Tech Mono';
  ctx.fillText((isF(latest)?latest.toFixed(1):'--')+' '+opt.unit,w-80,pad+11);
}

function renderHistoryPanels(){
  const s=chartState.lastStatus;
  drawHistoryChart('chart-temp-main',getMainSeries('temp_chamber',chartState.tempRange),{metric:'temp_chamber',unit:'°C',bands:getBands('temp_chamber',s)});
  drawHistoryChart('chart-temp-detail',getDetailSeries('temp_chamber'),{metric:'temp_chamber',unit:'°C',bands:getBands('temp_chamber',s)});
  drawHistoryChart('chart-hum-main',getMainSeries('humidity',chartState.humRange),{metric:'humidity',unit:'%',bands:getBands('humidity',s)});
  drawHistoryChart('chart-hum-detail',getDetailSeries('humidity'),{metric:'humidity',unit:'%',bands:getBands('humidity',s)});
}

function toggleBands(){chartState.showBands=!chartState.showBands;const btn=document.getElementById('btn-bands-toggle');if(btn)btn.textContent='Pasy ref: '+(chartState.showBands?'ON':'OFF');renderHistoryPanelsDeb();}
function toggleGauges(){const sec=document.getElementById('gauge-section-panel');const btn=document.getElementById('btn-gauge-toggle');if(!sec||!btn)return;const hidden=sec.classList.toggle('hidden');btn.textContent=(hidden?'Pokaż':'Ukryj')+' gauge';}
function toggleMemorySaving(){chartState.memorySaving=!chartState.memorySaving;const btn=document.getElementById('btn-memory-mode');if(btn)btn.textContent='Oszczędzanie pamięci: '+(chartState.memorySaving?'ON':'OFF');setText('memory-mode-label',chartState.memorySaving?'MAX 20 000 próbek':'MAX 30 000 próbek');renderHistoryPanelsDeb();}
function exportCSV(){const rows=[['timestamp','temp_chamber','temp_aquarium','humidity']];const a=historyStore.temp_chamber.raw,b=historyStore.temp_aquarium.raw,c=historyStore.humidity.raw;const n=Math.max(a.length,b.length,c.length);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const r0=a[i],r1=b[i],r2=c[i];const ts=r0?.ts||r1?.ts||r2?.ts||Date.now();rows.push([new Date(ts).toISOString(),r0?.v??'',r1?.v??'',r2?.v??'']);}const csv=rows.map(r=>r.join(',')).join('\n');const link=document.createElement('a');link.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv],{type:'text/csv'}));link.download='inkubator_'+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,19).replace(/:/g,'-')+'.csv';link.click();}
function clearHistory(){if(!confirm('Wyczyścić historię wykresów? Operacja nieodwracalna.'))return;for(const key of Object.keys(historyStore)){historyStore[key].raw.length=0;for(const l of AGG_LEVELS)historyStore[key].agg[l.key].length=0;}logEvent('cmd','Historia wyczyszczona');renderHistoryPanelsDeb();}

// ============================================================
// STEROWANIE — API CALLS
// ============================================================
function loadPowerPref(){try{const raw=localStorage.getItem(POWER_KEY);if(!raw)return;const d=JSON.parse(raw);if(d?.heater?.length===2)state.power.heater=[!!d.heater[0],!!d.heater[1]];if(d?.tray?.length===2)state.power.tray=[!!d.tray[0],!!d.tray[1]];if(typeof d?.diffuser==='boolean')state.power.diffuser=d.diffuser;}catch(e){}}
function savePowerPref(){try{localStorage.setItem(POWER_KEY,JSON.stringify(state.power));}catch(e){}}

function applyPowerUI(){
  for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
    const hOn=!!state.power.heater[i],tOn=!!state.power.tray[i];
    const hs=document.getElementById('sw-main-h'+i);if(hs)hs.checked=hOn;
    const ts=document.getElementById('sw-tray'+i);if(ts)ts.checked=tOn;
    setDisabled('sl-main-h'+i,!hOn);setDisabled('btn-main-h'+i+'-man',!hOn);setDisabled('btn-main-h'+i+'-auto',!hOn);
    setDisabled('main-day-tray'+i,!tOn);setDisabled('btn-main-day'+i,!tOn);setDisabled('main-dur-tray'+i,!tOn);setDisabled('main-spd-tray'+i,!tOn);setDisabled('btn-main-move'+i,!tOn);
  }
  const dOn=!!state.power.diffuser;
  const ds=document.getElementById('sw-diff');if(ds)ds.checked=dOn;
  setDisabled('btn-diff-on',!dOn);setDisabled('btn-diff-off',!dOn);setDisabled('btn-diff-auto',!dOn);
  updatePowerIndicators();
}
function setDisabled(id,disabled){const el=document.getElementById(id);if(el)el.disabled=!!disabled;}

async function toggleHeaterPower(ch,on){
  state.power.heater[ch]=!!on;savePowerPref();applyPowerUI();
  const st=document.getElementById('st-main-h'+ch);setMsg(st,'info','⏳ Zmiana...');
