async function confirmGlobalLockdown(){
  const lines=[];
  for(let i=0;i<2;i++){const sp=document.getElementById('main-species-tray'+i)?.value||'CHICKEN';const lockDay=SPECIES[sp]?.lockdown||speciesDays(sp);lines.push('Taca '+(i+1)+': '+shortSpecies(sp)+' → dzień '+lockDay);}
  if(!confirm('GLOBALNY LOCKDOWN:\n'+lines.join('\n')+'\n\nZatrzyma obroty dla obu tac.\nKontynuować?'))return;
  const st=document.getElementById('st-lockdown');setMsg(st,'info','⏳ Ustawianie lockdownu...');
  logEvent('lockdown','Globalny Lockdown uruchomiony przez użytkownika');
  let allOk=true;
  for(let i=0;i<2;i++){const sp=document.getElementById('main-species-tray'+i)?.value||'CHICKEN';const lockDay=SPECIES[sp]?.lockdown||speciesDays(sp);try{const r=await fetch('/api/tray/set-day?tray='+i+'&day='+lockDay,{method:'POST'});const d=await r.json();if(d.ok){state.tray[i].day=lockDay;setTimerAnchor(i,lockDay,sp);logEvent('lockdown','✓ T'+(i+1)+': D'+lockDay+' lockdown');}else{allOk=false;logEvent('lockdown','✗ T'+(i+1)+': '+(d.error||'błąd'));}}catch(e){allOk=false;logEvent('lockdown','✗ T'+(i+1)+': brak połączenia');}}
  setMsg(st,allOk?'ok':'warn',allOk?'✓ Lockdown aktywny':'⚠ Lockdown częściowy — sprawdź logi');
  updateTopTrays();updateLockdownPreview();
  if(allOk)setTimeout(fetchData,500);
}

function syncMainSpecies(i){
  const main=document.getElementById('main-species-tray'+i);
  if(main)state.tray[i].species=main.value;
  const badge=document.getElementById('badge-tray'+i+'-species');
  if(badge&&main)badge.textContent=shortSpecies(main.value);
  loadSchedule(i);
}

function loadSchedule(trayIdx){
  const spEl=document.getElementById('main-species-tray'+trayIdx)||document.getElementById('sched-species'+trayIdx);
  const mainBody=document.getElementById('main-sched-body'+trayIdx);
  const mainBadge=document.getElementById('main-sched-badge'+trayIdx);
  if(!spEl)return;
  const species=spEl.value,currentDay=state.tray[trayIdx].day||1;
  let rows=null;
  fetch('/api/schedule?species='+species).then(r=>r.json()).then(d=>{if(d.schedule&&d.schedule.length)rows=d.schedule;}).catch(()=>{}).finally(()=>{
    if(!rows){const sp=SPECIES[species]||SPECIES.CHICKEN;rows=[];for(let d=1;d<=sp.days;d++){const x=sp.rows(d);rows.push({day:d,temp_min:x.tmin,temp_max:x.tmax,humidity_min:x.hmin,humidity_max:x.hmax,turn:x.turn,lockdown:x.lockdown,notes:x.note});}}
    const html=rows.map(row=>{const today=row.day===currentDay,cls=today?'today':row.lockdown?'lockdown':'';return`<tr class="${cls}"><td>${today?'▶ ':''}${row.day}</td><td>${row.temp_min.toFixed(1)}–${row.temp_max.toFixed(1)}</td><td>${row.humidity_min}–${row.humidity_max}</td><td>${row.turn?'✓':'—'}</td><td>${row.lockdown?'<span class="lock-badge">LOCK</span>':''}</td><td style="font-size:10px;color:var(--vt-muted)">${row.notes||''}</td></tr>`;}).join('');
    if(mainBody)mainBody.innerHTML=html;
    if(mainBadge)mainBadge.textContent=shortSpecies(species)+' · D'+currentDay;
  });
}

// ============================================================
// EVENT LOG
// ============================================================
const eventLog=[];
function logEvent(type,msg){
  eventLog.push({ts:Date.now(),type,msg});
  if(eventLog.length>EVENT_LOG_MAX)eventLog.shift();
  const lv=document.getElementById('view-logi');
  if(lv&&lv.classList.contains('active'))renderEventLog();
}
function renderEventLog(){
  const filter=document.getElementById('log-filter')?.value||'';
  const list=document.getElementById('log-list');
  const count=document.getElementById('log-count');
  if(!list)return;
  const items=[...eventLog].reverse().filter(e=>!filter||e.type===filter);
  if(count)count.textContent=eventLog.length;
  if(!items.length){list.innerHTML='<div class="journal-empty">Brak logów pasujących do filtra.</div>';return;}
  list.innerHTML=items.map(e=>{
    const d=new Date(e.ts);
    const ts=d.toLocaleTimeString('pl-PL',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',second:'2-digit'});
    const icon={info:'ℹ',warn:'⚠',err:'✗',ok:'✓',cmd:'→',lockdown:'🔒'}[e.type]||'·';
    return`<div class="log-entry ${e.type}"><span class="log-ts">${ts}</span><span class="log-msg">${icon} ${e.msg}</span></div>`;
  }).join('');
}
function clearEventLog(){eventLog.length=0;renderEventLog();}
function exportEventLogCSV(){const rows=[['timestamp','type','message']];for(const e of eventLog)rows.push([new Date(e.ts).toISOString(),e.type,String(e.msg).replace(/,/g,';')]);const csv=rows.map(r=>r.join(',')).join('\n');const link=document.createElement('a');link.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv],{type:'text/csv'}));link.download='inkubator_logi_'+todayStr()+'.csv';link.click();}

// ============================================================
const journalState={batches:[]};
function journalSave(){try{localStorage.setItem(JOURNAL_STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify(journalState));}catch(e){if(e.name==='QuotaExceededError')logEvent('err','localStorage pełny! Archiwizuj lub usuń stare lęgi.');}}
function journalLoad(){try{const raw=localStorage.getItem(JOURNAL_STORAGE_KEY);if(!raw)return;const parsed=JSON.parse(raw);if(Array.isArray(parsed?.batches))journalState.batches=parsed.batches;}catch(e){}}
function activeBatches(){return journalState.batches.filter(b=>b.status!=='completed');}
function completedBatches(){return journalState.batches.filter(b=>b.status==='completed');}
function fillBatchSelect(selectId){const sel=document.getElementById(selectId);if(!sel)return;const active=activeBatches();if(!active.length){sel.innerHTML='<option value="">Brak aktywnych lęgów</option>';return;}sel.innerHTML=active.map(b=>`<option value="${b.id}">${b.trayName} · ${shortSpecies(b.species)} · D${calcIncubationDay(b.startDate,todayStr())||1}</option>`).join('');}
function journalRefreshDeviceTrayOptions(){const sel=document.getElementById('j-device-tray');if(!sel)return;const rows=[];for(let i=0;i<2;i++){const tray=deviceState.trays[i]||{};const day=tray.current_day||state.tray[i].day||1;const sp=tray.species||state.tray[i].species||'CHICKEN';rows.push(`<option value="${i}">Taca ${i+1} - ${shortSpecies(sp)} - dzień ${day}</option>`);}sel.innerHTML=rows.join('');}
function journalSyncFromDevice(){const sel=document.getElementById('j-device-tray');const status=document.getElementById('j-start-status');const hint=document.getElementById('j-device-hint');if(!sel)return;const idx=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,asNum(sel.value)));const tray=deviceState.trays[idx]||{};const species=tray.species||state.tray[idx].species||'CHICKEN';const day=tray.current_day||state.tray[idx].day||1;const inferredStart=new Date();inferredStart.setDate(inferredStart.getDate()-(Math.max(1,day)-1));const startStr=inferredStart.toISOString().slice(0,10);const startDateEl=document.getElementById('j-start-date');const trayNameEl=document.getElementById('j-tray-name');const speciesEl=document.getElementById('j-species');if(startDateEl)startDateEl.value=startStr;if(trayNameEl&&!trayNameEl.value)trayNameEl.value='Taca '+(idx+1);if(speciesEl)speciesEl.value=species;updateEstimatedPreview();if(hint)hint.textContent='Pobrano: Taca '+(idx+1)+', '+shortSpecies(species)+', dzień '+day;setMsg(status,'ok','✓ Uzupełniono formularz');}
function updateEstimatedPreview(){const start=document.getElementById('j-start-date')?.value||todayStr();const species=document.getElementById('j-species')?.value||'CHICKEN';setText('j-estimated',calcEstimatedHatchDate(start,species));}
function journalCreateBatch(){const startDate=document.getElementById('j-start-date')?.value||'';const trayName=(document.getElementById('j-tray-name')?.value||'').trim();const species=document.getElementById('j-species')?.value||'CHICKEN';const breed=(document.getElementById('j-breed')?.value||'').trim();const eggCount=asNum(document.getElementById('j-egg-count')?.value||0);const position=(document.getElementById('j-position')?.value||'').trim();const notes=(document.getElementById('j-start-notes')?.value||'').trim();const status=document.getElementById('j-start-status');if(!startDate||!trayName||eggCount<1){setMsg(status,'err','✗ Uzupełnij datę, tacę i ilość jaj');return;}const batch={id:'b_'+Date.now()+'_'+Math.floor(Math.random()*100000),startDate,trayName,species,breed,eggCount,estimatedHatchDate:calcEstimatedHatchDate(startDate,species),position,notes,createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),status:'active',dailyNotes:[],candling:{fertile:null,clear:null,bloodRing:null,lastUpdate:null},summary:{hatchedHealthy:0,hatchedWeak:0,deadInShell:0,notes:'',completedDate:null}};journalState.batches.unshift(batch);journalSave();setMsg(status,'ok','✓ Dodano nowy lęg');journalRefreshUI();}
function journalAddDailyNote(){const batchId=document.getElementById('j-note-batch')?.value||'';const status=document.getElementById('j-note-status');const batch=journalState.batches.find(b=>b.id===batchId);if(!batch){setMsg(status,'err','✗ Wybierz aktywny lęg');return;}const date=document.getElementById('j-note-date')?.value||todayStr();const dayInput=asNum(document.getElementById('j-note-day')?.value||0);const day=dayInput>0?dayInput:(calcIncubationDay(batch.startDate,date)||1);const weightRaw=document.getElementById('j-note-weight')?.value;const weight=weightRaw===''?null:asNum(weightRaw);const text=(document.getElementById('j-note-text')?.value||'').trim();const fertileRaw=document.getElementById('j-candled-fertile')?.value;const clearRaw=document.getElementById('j-candled-clear')?.value;const bloodRaw=document.getElementById('j-candled-blood')?.value;if(!text&&fertileRaw===''&&clearRaw===''&&bloodRaw===''){setMsg(status,'err','✗ Dodaj notatkę lub dane ovoskopii');return;}batch.dailyNotes.unshift({id:'n_'+Date.now(),date,day,text,weight,photoUrl:''});if(fertileRaw!==''||clearRaw!==''||bloodRaw!==''){batch.candling.fertile=fertileRaw===''?batch.candling.fertile:asNum(fertileRaw);batch.candling.clear=clearRaw===''?batch.candling.clear:asNum(clearRaw);batch.candling.bloodRing=bloodRaw===''?batch.candling.bloodRing:asNum(bloodRaw);batch.candling.lastUpdate=new Date().toISOString();}journalSave();setMsg(status,'ok','✓ Zapisano wpis dzienny');journalRefreshUI();}
function journalSaveSummary(){const batchId=document.getElementById('j-summary-batch')?.value||'';const status=document.getElementById('j-summary-status');const batch=journalState.batches.find(b=>b.id===batchId);if(!batch){setMsg(status,'err','✗ Wybierz aktywny lęg');return;}batch.summary.hatchedHealthy=asNum(document.getElementById('j-hatched-healthy')?.value||0);batch.summary.hatchedWeak=asNum(document.getElementById('j-hatched-weak')?.value||0);batch.summary.deadInShell=asNum(document.getElementById('j-hatched-dead')?.value||0);batch.summary.notes=(document.getElementById('j-summary-notes')?.value||'').trim();batch.summary.completedDate=todayStr();batch.status='completed';journalSave();setMsg(status,'ok','✓ Lęg zamknięty');journalRefreshUI();}
function journalExportCSV(){const rows=[['tray','species','breed','start_date','estimated_hatch','status','eggs','hatched_healthy','hatched_weak','dead_in_shell','hatch_pct','fertility_pct','notes']];for(const b of journalState.batches){const fert=calcFertilityPercent(b);rows.push([b.trayName||'',shortSpecies(b.species),b.breed||'',b.startDate||'',b.estimatedHatchDate||'',b.status||'',asNum(b.eggCount),asNum(b.summary?.hatchedHealthy),asNum(b.summary?.hatchedWeak),asNum(b.summary?.deadInShell),calcHatchPercent(b).toFixed(1),fert==null?'':fert.toFixed(1),(b.summary?.notes||b.notes||'').replace(/\n/g,' ')]);}const csv=rows.map(r=>r.join(',')).join('\n');const link=document.createElement('a');link.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv],{type:'text/csv'}));link.download='inkubator_dziennik_'+todayStr()+'.csv';link.click();}
function journalPrintReport(){const report=journalState.batches.map(b=>{const fert=calcFertilityPercent(b);return`<h3>${b.trayName} - ${shortSpecies(b.species)} ${b.breed?('('+b.breed+')'):''}</h3><p>Start: ${b.startDate} | Wylęg: ${b.estimatedHatchDate} | Jaj: ${b.eggCount}</p><p>Status: ${b.status} | Wylęg: ${calcHatchPercent(b).toFixed(1)}% | Zapłodnienie: ${fert==null?'--':fert.toFixed(1)+'%'}</p>`;}).join('');const w=window.open('','_blank');if(!w)return;w.document.write('<html><head><title>Raport z lęgu</title></head><body><h1>Raport z lęgu</h1>'+report+'</body></html>');w.document.close();w.print();}
function renderJournalActive(){const root=document.getElementById('j-active-list');if(!root)return;const active=activeBatches();if(!active.length){root.innerHTML='<div class="journal-empty">Brak aktywnych lęgów.</div>';return;}root.innerHTML=active.map(b=>{const fert=calcFertilityPercent(b);const day=calcIncubationDay(b.startDate,todayStr())||1;const totalD=speciesDays(b.species),lockD=SPECIES[b.species]?.lockdown||totalD;const isLock=day>=lockD,remain=totalD-day;const pct=Math.min(100,Math.round(day/totalD*100));const pColor=isLock?'var(--vt-purple)':(remain<=3?'var(--vt-amber)':'var(--vt-green)');const remainStr=remain<=0?'🐣 wylęg!':(isLock?'LOCKDOWN · za '+remain+'d':remain+'d');const recentNotes=(b.dailyNotes||[]).slice(0,3).map(n=>`<div class="journal-note" style="border-left:1px solid var(--vt-border);padding-left:6px;margin-top:4px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between"><div>D${n.day}: ${n.text||'(brak opisu)'}${n.weight!=null?` [${n.weight}g]`:''}</div><div style="display:flex;gap:3px"><button class="vtbtn" style="padding:1px 4px;font-size:9px" onclick="editDailyNote('${b.id}','${n.id}')">✎</button>

<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Share+Tech+Mono&family=Oswald:wght@300;400;500;600&family=VT323&display=swap');
:root{
  --vt-green:#39d35f;--vt-green2:#22c55e;--vt-dim:#1c3a22;--vt-bg:#070d07;--vt-bg2:#0b140b;--vt-bg3:#111c11;
  --vt-border:rgba(57,211,95,.18);--vt-border2:rgba(57,211,95,.35);
  --vt-text:#c8e8c8;--vt-muted:rgba(200,232,200,.45);--vt-amber:#f5a623;--vt-red:#ef4444;--vt-blue:#38bdf8;
  --vt-yellow:#eab308;--vt-purple:#a78bfa;

}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html,body{background:var(--vt-bg);color:var(--vt-text);font-family:var(--font-main);font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;min-height:100vh}
::selection{background:rgba(57,211,95,.3)}
body::before{content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;background:var(--scan);pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;opacity:.6}

/* topbar, tabs, karty, przyciski, tabele – zachowujemy cały styl z poprzedniej wersji (jest bardzo rozbudowany) */
.topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;height:48px;background:rgba(6,10,6,.98);border-bottom:1px solid var(--vt-border2);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100;overflow:hidden}
.topbar::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--vt-green),transparent)}
.tb-logo{padding:0 20px;border-right:1px solid var(--vt-border);height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;min-width:180px}

.tb-right{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:0 12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.vtbadge{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.1em;padding:2px 7px;border:1px solid;font-family:var(--font-main);text-transform:uppercase}
.vtbadge-ok{color:var(--vt-green);border-color:rgba(57,211,95,.4);background:rgba(57,211,95,.06)}
.vtbadge-warn{color:var(--vt-yellow);border-color:rgba(234,179,8,.4);background:rgba(234,179,8,.06)}
.vtbadge-hot{color:var(--vt-red);border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.4);background:rgba(239,68,68,.06)}
.vtbadge-lock{color:var(--vt-purple);border-color:rgba(167,139,250,.4);background:rgba(167,139,250,.06)}
.vtbadge-info{color:var(--vt-blue);border-color:rgba(56,189,248,.4);background:rgba(56,189,248,.06)}
.dot6{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--vt-muted);display:inline-block;margin-right:4px}
.dot6.ok{background:var(--vt-green);box-shadow:0 0 5px var(--vt-green)}
.dot6.warn{background:var(--vt-yellow);box-shadow:0 0 5px var(--vt-yellow)}
.dot6.err{background:var(--vt-red);box-shadow:0 0 5px var(--vt-red);animation:blink 1s infinite}
@keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.3}}
.tray-chip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;border:1px solid var(--vt-border);padding:3px 8px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.06em}
.tray-chip.lockdown{border-color:rgba(167,139,250,.5);color:var(--vt-purple)}
.tray-chip.hatch{border-color:rgba(57,211,95,.6);color:var(--vt-green);animation:blink .8s infinite}
.tabs{display:flex;background:rgba(6,10,6,.95);border-bottom:1px solid var(--vt-border);overflow-x:auto}
.tab{padding:10px 20px;font-family:var(--font-main);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--vt-muted);border:none;background:none;cursor:pointer;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;white-space:nowrap}
.tab:hover{color:var(--vt-text)}
.tab.active{color:var(--vt-green);border-bottom-color:var(--vt-green);text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(57,211,95,.4)}
.main{padding:16px 20px;max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto}
.view{display:none}.view.active{display:block}
.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
.grid3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px}
.grid4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px}
@media(max-width:1100px){.grid3{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:800px){.grid2,.grid3,.grid4{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.vtcard{background:rgba(6,10,6,.97);border:1px solid var(--vt-border);padding:14px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.vtcard::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--scan);pointer-events:none}
.vtcard.alarm{border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.5);box-shadow:inset 0 0 20px rgba(239,68,68,.05)}
.vtcard-title{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--vt-muted);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:10px;padding-bottom:7px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--vt-border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.sec{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:rgba(57,211,95,.5);text-transform:uppercase;margin:18px 0 10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.sec::after{content:'';flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--vt-border)}
.gauge-outer{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.gauge-canvas{display:block}
.gauge-label-below{font-family:var(--font-vt);text-align:center;font-size:28px;color:var(--vt-green);letter-spacing:.05em;line-height:1;text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(57,211,95,.5)}
.gauge-label-below.warn{color:var(--vt-yellow)}
.gauge-label-below.hot{color:var(--vt-red)}
.ring-canvas{display:block;margin:0 auto}
.tray-info-box{text-align:center;margin-top:6px}
.hatch-status{margin-top:8px;padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--vt-border);background:rgba(6,10,6,.5)}
.hatch-title{font-family:var(--font-title);font-size:12px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--vt-green)}
.hatch-timers{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px}
.timer-chip{font-size:10px;padding:3px 8px;border:1px solid var(--vt-border2);color:var(--vt-green);letter-spacing:.05em}
.timer-chip.down{color:var(--vt-amber);border-color:rgba(245,166,35,.35)}
.power-item{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--vt-border)}
.vt-switch{position:relative;width:50px;height:22px;cursor:pointer}
.vt-switch input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:0;height:0}
.vt-track{position:absolute;inset:0;border:1px solid rgba(57,211,95,.3);background:rgba(6,10,6,.9);transition:all .2s}
.vt-track::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:16px;height:16px;background:#4a6b4a;transition:all .2s}
.vt-switch input:checked ~ .vt-track{border-color:rgba(57,211,95,.7);background:rgba(57,211,95,.08)}
.vt-switch input:checked ~ .vt-track::before{left:30px;background:var(--vt-green);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(57,211,95,.6)}
.vtbtn{font-family:var(--font-main);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:6px 14px;border:1px solid var(--vt-border2);background:rgba(57,211,95,.06);color:var(--vt-green);cursor:pointer}
.vtbtn:hover{background:rgba(57,211,95,.14);border-color:rgba(57,211,95,.6)}
.vtbtn-danger{border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.4);background:rgba(239,68,68,.06);color:var(--vt-red)}
.vtbtn-info{border-color:rgba(56,189,248,.4);background:rgba(56,189,248,.06);color:var(--vt-blue)}
.vtbtn-full{width:100%}
.btn-lockdown{font-family:var(--font-title);font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.2em;font-weight:500;text-transform:uppercase;padding:12px;border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.5);background:rgba(239,68,68,.1);color:var(--vt-red);cursor:pointer;width:100%}
.pip-clock-block{background:rgba(6,10,6,.97);border:1px solid var(--vt-border);padding:10px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.pip-time{font-family:var(--font-vt);font-size:42px;color:var(--vt-green);letter-spacing:.08em;line-height:1}
.pip-date{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--vt-muted)}
.vt-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px}
.vt-table th{text-align:left;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--vt-muted);padding:6px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--vt-border)}
.vt-table td{padding:6px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(57,211,95,.06);color:var(--vt-text)}
.log-list{max-height:60vh;overflow-y:auto}
.log-entry{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:4px 8px;font-size:11px;border:1px solid transparent}
.log-ts{color:var(--vt-muted);flex-shrink:0}
.esp-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--vt-border)}
.ctrl-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:6px 0}
.ctrl-lbl{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--vt-muted);min-width:80px}
.vmsg{font-size:10px;margin-top:5px;padding:3px 6px}
.journal-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.journal-entry{background:rgba(6,10,6,.95);border:1px solid var(--vt-border);padding:10px}
.stat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:10px}
.stat-tile{background:rgba(6,10,6,.95);border:1px solid var(--vt-border);padding:10px}
.stat-val{font-family:var(--font-vt);font-size:24px;color:var(--vt-green)}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header class="topbar"><div class="tb-logo"><div class="tb-logo-main">VAULT-TEC</div><div class="tb-logo-sub">INCUBATOR CORE</div></div>
<div class="tb-stats"><div class="tb-stat"><div class="tb-stat-label"><span class="dot6" id="apiDot"></span>API</div><div class="tb-stat-val" id="apiStatusTop">--</div></div>
<div class="tb-stat"><div class="tb-stat-label"><span class="dot6" id="espDot"></span>ESP</div><div class="tb-stat-val" id="espTempTop">--°C</div></div>
<div class="tb-stat"><div class="tb-stat-label">UPTIME</div><div class="tb-stat-val" id="uptimeTop">--:--:--</div></div></div>
<div style="display:flex;gap:5px;align-items:center;padding:0 10px" id="topbar-trays"></div>
<div class="tb-right" id="topbarBadges"></div></header>
<nav class="tabs"><button class="tab active" data-tab="status" onclick="showTab('status')">■ STATUS</button><button class="tab" data-tab="panel" onclick="showTab('panel')">▶ STEROWANIE</button><button class="tab" data-tab="dziennik" onclick="showTab('dziennik')">◎ DZIENNIK</button><button class="tab" data-tab="serwis" onclick="showTab('serwis')">◈ SERWIS</button><button class="tab" data-tab="logi" onclick="showTab('logi')">≡ LOGI</button></nav>

<!-- STATUS (skrócony dla czytelności) -->
<div id="view-status" class="view active main"><div class="pip-clock-block" style="float:right;width:auto;margin-bottom:10px"><div class="pip-time" id="pip-clock">--:--:--</div><div class="pip-date" id="pip-date">SYSTEM TIME</div></div>
<div class="sec">KOMORA</div><div class="grid3"><div class="vtcard"><div class="vtcard-title">TEMPERATURA KOMORY</div><canvas id="g-temp" class="gauge-canvas" width="200" height="110"></canvas><div class="gauge-label-below" id="mainTemp">--°C</div></div>
<div class="vtcard"><div class="vtcard-title">WILGOTNOŚĆ</div><canvas id="g-hum" class="gauge-canvas" width="200" height="110"></canvas><div class="gauge-label-below" id="mainHum">--%</div></div>
<div class="vtcard"><div class="vtcard-title">TEMPERATURA AKWARIUM</div><canvas id="g-aqua" class="gauge-canvas" width="200" height="110"></canvas><div class="gauge-label-below" id="mainAqua">--°C</div></div></div>
<div class="sec">TACE</div><div class="grid2" id="trayStatusCards"></div></div>

<!-- STEROWANIE (skrót) -->
<div id="view-panel" class="view main"><div class="sec">STEROWANIE GRZAŁKAMI</div><div class="grid2" id="heaterPanel"></div><div class="sec">TACE</div><div class="grid2" id="trayPanel"></div><button class="btn-lockdown" onclick="globalLockdown()">⚠ GLOBALNY LOCKDOWN</button></div>

<!-- DZIENNIK -->
<div id="view-dziennik" class="view main"><div class="sec">NOWY LĘG</div><div class="vtcard"><div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Taca</div><input type="text" id="newTrayName" placeholder="np. Taca 1"></div>
<div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Gatunek</div><select id="newSpecies"><option value="CHICKEN">Kura</option><option value="DUCK">Kaczka</option><option value="GOOSE">Gęś</option><option value="QUAIL">Przepiórka</option></select></div>
<div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Data startu</div><input type="date" id="newStartDate"></div>
<div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Ilość jaj</div><input type="number" id="newEggCount" value="20"></div>
<button class="vtbtn" onclick="addBatch()">➕ DODAJ LĘG</button><div class="vmsg" id="journalMsg"></div></div>
<div class="sec">AKTYWNE LĘGI</div><div id="activeBatchesList" class="journal-list"></div>
<div class="sec">ARCHIWUM / STATYSTYKI</div><div class="vtcard" id="statsSummary"></div>
<div class="vtcard"><div id="archiveTable"></div></div>
<button class="vtbtn vtbtn-danger" onclick="clearJournal()">✗ USUŃ WSZYSTKIE DANE</button>
</div>

<!-- SERWIS (skrót) -->
<div id="view-serwis" class="view main"><div class="sec">GPIO MAP</div><div class="vtcard"><div class="esp-row"><span>DS18B20</span><span>GPIO 6</span></div><div class="esp-row"><span>DHT11</span><span>GPIO 8</span></div><div class="esp-row"><span>RTC I2C</span><span>GPIO4/5</span></div><div class="esp-row"><span>Grzałki PWM</span><span>GPIO1/2</span></div><div class="esp-row"><span>Silniki tac</span><span>GPIO16/17</span></div></div></div>

<!-- LOGI -->
<div id="view-logi" class="view main"><div class="sec">LOG ZDARZEŃ</div><div class="vtcard"><div id="eventLogContainer" class="log-list"></div></div></div>

<script>
// ===================== STAN GLOBALNY =====================
let eventLog = [];
const MAX_LOG = 150;
let apiPollInterval = null;
let currentTrays = [{day:5,species:"CHICKEN"},{day:8,species:"CHICKEN"}];
let powerState = {heater0:true, heater1:true, tray0:true, tray1:true, diffuser:true};
let journalBatches = [];

// ===================== POMOCNICZE =====================
function addLog(type, msg) { eventLog.unshift({ts:Date.now(),type,msg}); if(eventLog.length>MAX_LOG) eventLog.pop(); renderEventLog(); }
function renderEventLog() { const container = document.getElementById('eventLogContainer'); if(!container)return; container.innerHTML = eventLog.map(e=>`<div class="log-entry ${e.type}"><span class="log-ts">${new Date(e.ts).toLocaleTimeString()}</span><span>${e.msg}</span></div>`).join('') || '<div class="journal-empty">Brak logów</div>'; }
function showTab(tabId) { document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v=>v.classList.remove('active')); document.getElementById(`view-${tabId}`).classList.add('active'); document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t=>t.classList.remove('active')); document.querySelector(`.tab[data-tab="${tabId}"]`).classList.add('active'); if(tabId==='dziennik') refreshJournalUI(); if(tabId==='status') refreshStatusUI(); if(tabId==='panel') refreshPanelUI(); }
function shortSpecies(s) { return {CHICKEN:"Kura",DUCK:"Kaczka",GOOSE:"Gęś",QUAIL:"Przepiórka"}[s]||s; }
function speciesDays(s) { return {CHICKEN:21,DUCK:28,GOOSE:30,QUAIL:17}[s]||21; }
function calcDay(startDate, ref=null) { if(!startDate) return 1; const start=new Date(startDate); const now=ref?new Date(ref):new Date(); const diff=Math.floor((now-start)/86400000); return Math.max(1,Math.min(speciesDays(startDate.split('-').length?startDate:'2025-01-01'), diff+1)); }
function formatDuration(ms) { let d=Math.floor(ms/86400000), h=Math.floor((ms%86400000)/3600000); return d>0?`${d}d ${h}h`:`${h}h`; }
function updateClock() { const d=new Date(); document.getElementById('pip-clock').innerText=d.toLocaleTimeString('pl-PL'); document.getElementById('pip-date').innerText=d.toLocaleDateString('pl-PL'); }
setInterval(updateClock,1000); updateClock();

// ===================== SYMULACJA API (dla demo, ale zgodna z endpointami) =====================
async function fetchMockStatus() { return { temp_chamber:37.2, temp_aquarium:36.8, humidity:54, target_temp:37.5, heater_pwm_ch0:42, heater_pwm_ch1:38, heater_manual_ch0:false, heater_manual_ch1:false, diffuser_on:true, diffuser_manual_mode:false, uptime_ms:123456789, esp_free_heap:180000, esp_internal_temp:48 }; }
async function fetchMockTrays() { return { trays:[ {current_day:currentTrays[0].day, species:currentTrays[0].species, last_rotation_hour:10, last_rotation_day:5}, {current_day:currentTrays[1].day, species:currentTrays[1].species, last_rotation_hour:14, last_rotation_day:8} ] }; }
async function fetchData() { try { const [status, trays] = await Promise.all([fetchMockStatus(), fetchMockTrays()]); updateUIFromAPI(status, trays); addLog('ok','Odświeżono dane'); } catch(e) { addLog('err','Błąd API'); } }
function updateUIFromAPI(s, t) { document.getElementById('apiStatusTop').innerText='OK'; document.getElementById('apiDot').className='dot6 ok'; document.getElementById('espTempTop').innerHTML=(s.esp_internal_temp||0).toFixed(1)+'°C'; document.getElementById('uptimeTop').innerText=Math.floor(s.uptime_ms/3600000)+'h'; drawGauge('g-temp', s.temp_chamber,37,38,0,45); drawGauge('g-hum', s.humidity,45,65,20,90); drawGauge('g-aqua', s.temp_aquarium,36.5,37.8,0,45); document.getElementById('mainTemp').innerHTML=s.temp_chamber.toFixed(1)+'°C'; document.getElementById('mainHum').innerHTML=s.humidity.toFixed(0)+'%'; document.getElementById('mainAqua').innerHTML=s.temp_aquarium.toFixed(1)+'°C'; currentTrays = t.trays.map((tr,i)=>({day:tr.current_day, species:tr.species||'CHICKEN'})); refreshStatusUI(); refreshPanelUI(); }
function drawGauge(cid, val, okMin, okMax, minV, maxV) { const canvas=document.getElementById(cid); if(!canvas)return; const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d'); const w=canvas.width, h=canvas.height; ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h); const cx=w/2, cy=h-15, r=Math.min(w*0.4, h-25); const start=Math.PI*0.8, end=Math.PI*2.2; const mapAng=(v)=>start+((v-minV)/(maxV-minV))*(end-start); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,r,start,end); ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(57,211,95,0.2)'; ctx.lineWidth=12; ctx.stroke(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,r,mapAng(Math.min(maxV,Math.max(minV,val))),end); ctx.strokeStyle=val>=okMin&&val<=okMax?'#39d35f':(val>okMax?'#ef4444':'#eab308'); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle='#39d35f'; ctx.font='bold 16px monospace'; ctx.fillText(val.toFixed(1),cx-15,cy-15); }

function refreshStatusUI() { const container=document.getElementById('trayStatusCards'); if(!container)return; container.innerHTML=currentTrays.map((tr,i)=>`<div class="vtcard"><div class="vtcard-title">TACA ${i+1} · ${shortSpecies(tr.species)}</div><div class="hatch-title">Dzień ${tr.day} / ${speciesDays(tr.species)}</div><div class="hatch-timers"><span class="timer-chip">Obroty: ${tr.day>speciesDays(tr.species)-3?'LOCKDOWN':'AKTYWNE'}</span></div></div>`).join(''); }
function refreshPanelUI() { const heaterDiv=document.getElementById('heaterPanel'); if(heaterDiv) heaterDiv.innerHTML=`<div class="vtcard"><div class="vtcard-title">GRZAŁKA KOMORA</div><label class="vt-switch"><input type="checkbox" id="h0Toggle" ${powerState.heater0?'checked':''} onchange="toggleHeater(0,this.checked)"><span class="vt-track"></span></label><button class="vtbtn" onclick="setHeaterManual(0,60)">Ręcznie 60%</button></div><div class="vtcard"><div class="vtcard-title">GRZAŁKA AKWARIUM</div><label class="vt-switch"><input type="checkbox" id="h1Toggle" ${powerState.heater1?'checked':''} onchange="toggleHeater(1,this.checked)"><span class="vt-track"></span></label><button class="vtbtn" onclick="setHeaterManual(1,50)">Ręcznie 50%</button></div>`; const trayDiv=document.getElementById('trayPanel'); if(trayDiv) trayDiv.innerHTML=currentTrays.map((tr,i)=>`<div class="vtcard"><div class="vtcard-title">TACA ${i+1} · ${shortSpecies(tr.species)}</div><div class="ctrl-row"><div class="ctrl-lbl">Dzień</div><input type="number" id="dayInput${i}" value="${tr.day}" min="1" max="40"><button class="vtbtn" onclick="setTrayDay(${i},document.getElementById('dayInput${i}').value)">Ustaw</button></div><div><label class="vt-switch"><input type="checkbox" id="trayPower${i}" ${powerState[`tray${i}`]?'checked':''} onchange="toggleTrayPower(${i},this.checked)"><span class="vt-track"></span></label></div><button class="vtbtn vtbtn-full" onclick="rotateTray(${i})">🔄 OBRÓĆ TACĘ</button></div>`).join(''); }
function toggleHeater(ch,on) { powerState[`heater${ch}`]=on; addLog('cmd',`Grzałka ${ch+1} ${on?'włączona':'wyłączona'}`); refreshPanelUI(); }
function setHeaterManual(ch,pct) { if(!powerState[`heater${ch}`]) { addLog('warn','Najpierw włącz impuls'); return; } addLog('cmd',`Grzałka ${ch+1} ręcznie ${pct}%`); }
function toggleTrayPower(i,on) { powerState[`tray${i}`]=on; addLog('cmd',`Taca ${i+1} zasilanie ${on?'ON':'OFF'}`); refreshPanelUI(); }
function setTrayDay(i,day) { const d=parseInt(day); if(d>0 && d<=40) { currentTrays[i].day=d; addLog('cmd',`Taca ${i+1} dzień ${d}`); refreshStatusUI(); refreshPanelUI(); } else addLog('err','Nieprawidłowy dzień'); }
function rotateTray(i) { if(!powerState[`tray${i}`]) { addLog('warn',`Taca ${i+1} odcięta`); return; } addLog('cmd',`Ręczny obrót tacy ${i+1}`); setTimeout(()=>addLog('ok',`Taca ${i+1} zakończyła ruch`),2000); }
function globalLockdown() { if(confirm('LOCKDOWN: ustaw obie tace w tryb końcowy? Zatrzyma obroty.')) { currentTrays.forEach((_,i)=>setTrayDay(i,speciesDays(currentTrays[i].species)-1)); addLog('lockdown','GLOBALNY LOCKDOWN AKTYWNY'); } }

// ===================== DZIENNIK (localStorage) =====================
function loadJournal() { const raw=localStorage.getItem('vt_hatchery_journal'); if(raw) try{ journalBatches=JSON.parse(raw); }catch(e){} if(!Array.isArray(journalBatches)) journalBatches=[]; }
function saveJournal() { localStorage.setItem('vt_hatchery_journal',JSON.stringify(journalBatches)); refreshJournalUI(); }
function addBatch() { const trayName=document.getElementById('newTrayName').value.trim(); const species=document.getElementById('newSpecies').value; const startDate=document.getElementById('newStartDate').value; const eggCount=parseInt(document.getElementById('newEggCount').value); if(!trayName||!startDate||eggCount<1) { document.getElementById('journalMsg').innerText='Wypełnij wszystkie pola'; return; } const id=Date.now()+'_'+Math.random(); journalBatches.unshift({ id, trayName, species, startDate, eggCount, status:'active', dailyNotes:[], summary:{} }); saveJournal(); document.getElementById('journalMsg').innerText='Dodano lęg'; document.getElementById('newTrayName').value=''; document.getElementById('newStartDate').value=''; }
function refreshJournalUI() { renderActiveBatches(); renderArchiveStats(); }
function renderActiveBatches() { const container=document.getElementById('activeBatchesList'); if(!container)return; const active=journalBatches.filter(b=>b.status!=='completed'); if(!active.length) { container.innerHTML='<div class="journal-empty">Brak aktywnych lęgów</div>'; return; } container.innerHTML=active.map(b=>{ const day=calcDay(b.startDate); const total=speciesDays(b.species); return `<div class="journal-entry"><h4>${b.trayName} · ${shortSpecies(b.species)}</h4><div>Dzień ${day}/${total} · Jaj: ${b.eggCount}</div><div class="ctrl-row"><input type="text" id="note_${b.id}" placeholder="notatka dzienna"><button class="vtbtn" onclick="addDailyNote('${b.id}',document.getElementById('note_${b.id}').value)">✎ DODAJ WPIS</button></div><button class="vtbtn vtbtn-danger" onclick="completeBatch('${b.id}')">✔ ZAMKNIJ LĘG</button></div>`; }).join(''); }
function addDailyNote(batchId, text) { if(!text.trim()) return; const batch=journalBatches.find(b=>b.id===batchId); if(batch) { batch.dailyNotes=batch.dailyNotes||[]; batch.dailyNotes.unshift({date:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10), day:calcDay(batch.startDate), text }); saveJournal(); addLog('ok',`Notatka dodana do ${batch.trayName}`); } }
function completeBatch(batchId) { const batch=journalBatches.find(b=>b.id===batchId); if(batch && confirm(`Zamknąć lęg ${batch.trayName}?`)) { batch.status='completed'; batch.completedDate=new Date().toISOString(); saveJournal(); } }
function renderArchiveStats() { const statsDiv=document.getElementById('statsSummary'); if(!statsDiv)return; const completed=journalBatches.filter(b=>b.status==='completed'); const totalEggs=completed.reduce((s,b)=>s+(b.eggCount||0),0); const avgHatch=completed.length? (completed.reduce((s,b)=>s+((b.summary?.hatchedHealthy||0)/Math.max(1,b.eggCount)*100),0)/completed.length).toFixed(1):0; statsDiv.innerHTML=`<div class="stat-grid"><div class="stat-tile"><div class="stat-label">ZAKOŃCZONE LĘGI</div><div class="stat-val">${completed.length}</div></div><div class="stat-tile"><div class="stat-label">ŚREDNI WYLĘG</div><div class="stat-val">${avgHatch}%</div></div><div class="stat-tile"><div class="stat-label">ŁĄCZNIE JAJ</div><div class="stat-val">${totalEggs}</div></div></div>`; const archiveTable=document.getElementById('archiveTable'); if(archiveTable) archiveTable.innerHTML=`<table class="vt-table"><thead><tr><th>Taca</th><th>Gatunek</th><th>Start</th><th>Jaja</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>${journalBatches.slice(0,20).map(b=>`<tr><td>${b.trayName}</td><td>${shortSpecies(b.species)}</td><td>${b.startDate}</td><td>${b.eggCount}</td><td>${b.status==='completed'?'✔ Zakończony':'🔴 Aktywny'}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`; }
function clearJournal() { if(confirm('USUNĄĆ WSZYSTKIE DANE DZIENNIKA? Nieodwracalne.')) { journalBatches=[]; saveJournal(); addLog('cmd','Dziennik wyczyszczony'); } }

// ===================== INICJALIZACJA =====================
function init() { loadJournal(); refreshJournalUI(); fetchData(); apiPollInterval=setInterval(fetchData,5000); refreshStatusUI(); refreshPanelUI(); renderEventLog(); addLog('info','System Vault-Tec aktywny'); }
window.showTab=showTab; window.toggleHeater=toggleHeater; window.setHeaterManual=setHeaterManual; window.toggleTrayPower=toggleTrayPower; window.setTrayDay=setTrayDay; window.rotateTray=rotateTray; window.globalLockdown=globalLockdown; window.addBatch=addBatch; window.addDailyNote=addDailyNote; window.completeBatch=completeBatch; window.clearJournal=clearJournal;
init();
</script>
</body>
